observations.description: Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide. We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s. We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire. About The Role You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture. This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when. You'll report to the VP of Engineering , Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this. What You'll Do Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security. Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation. Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do. Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no." Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it. Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team. What You'll Bring Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth. Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook. An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code. Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling. Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you. Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus. Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus. What's Cool About The Role You define the function. observations.description: About the role The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company. About Arabian Private Holdings Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets. What you will do Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment. Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations. Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies. Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals. Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates. Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized. Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews. Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports. What we are looking for A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving. Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors. Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English. Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors. Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review. A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics. How we work We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients. What the role offers A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market. Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates. Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region. The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote. Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health. observations.description: The Role: We are looking for an experienced SEO Specialist to support our agency and client accounts on an hourly and/or project basis. This role is best suited for someone with a strong understanding of the technical and on-page sides of SEO who can independently analyze websites, identify opportunities, develop recommendations, and translate SEO findings into actionable strategies. The ideal candidate understands how websites are structured, how search engines crawl and interpret content, and how on-page and technical factors influence organic visibility. They will also have an understanding of the evolving search landscape, including AI-generated search results, LLMs, AI Overviews, and emerging approaches to optimizing content and websites for AI-driven discovery. Key Responsibilities: Technical & On-Page SEO Conduct technical and on-page SEO audits for client websites. Analyze site architecture, crawlability, indexation, internal linking, redirects, canonicalization, metadata, structured data/schema, page speed/Core Web Vitals, and other technical SEO factors. Review title tags, meta descriptions, headers, URLs, content structure, internal linking, image optimization, and other on-page elements. Identify technical issues and prioritize recommendations based on SEO impact and level of effort. Evaluate website architecture and make recommendations for improving search engine accessibility and user experience. Identify opportunities to improve existing pages rather than relying solely on creating new content. Understand local SEO fundamentals where applicable, including location-based optimization and local search visibility. SEO Research & Strategy Conduct keyword research and develop keyword/topic strategies. Analyze search intent and identify opportunities based on how users are searching. Perform competitive SEO research and identify gaps and opportunities. Analyze SERPs to understand what search engines are rewarding for specific queries. Develop actionable SEO recommendations for websites and individual pages. Stay current with changes to Google and other search engines and their ranking systems. Content Briefs & Recommendations Develop detailed SEO-focused content briefs for writers and clients. Provide recommendations for page topics, keyword targeting, search intent, headings, content structure, internal links, FAQs, and other on-page opportunities. Review existing content and recommend updates, consolidation, expansion, or optimization. Provide guidance on how content can better satisfy search intent and compete in the SERPs. Work with content teams to ensure SEO strategy is incorporated into content development. SEO Reporting & Analysis Create clear, client-friendly SEO reports and audits. Analyze organic traffic, rankings, conversions, visibility, and other relevant SEO performance indicators. Translate data into meaningful insights and actionable recommendations rather than simply presenting metrics. Identify trends, opportunities, and potential issues within SEO performance. Be comfortable working with tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics/GA4, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and similar SEO platforms. SEO & LLM / AI Search Understand how search is evolving beyond traditional Google results. Have familiarity with Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other LLM-driven search/discovery experiences. Understand emerging concepts around Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI search visibility, entity optimization, structured content, and content designed to be understood and surfaced by AI systems. Evaluate websites and content for opportunities to improve visibility across both traditional search engines and AI-driven search experiences. Stay informed about changes in how users discover information through search engines and LLMs. Requirements: 2+ years SEO experience preferred Strong technical and on-page SEO knowledge. Experience with Google Search Console and GA4. Experience with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or comparable SEO tools. Understanding of schema/structured data. Understanding of site architecture, crawlability, indexation, and internal linking. Strong keyword research and search intent skills. Experience creating SEO audits and client-facing reports. Experience developing SEO content briefs. Familiarity with local SEO is a plus. Experience with WordPress, Squarespace, Webflow, Shopify, or other common CMS platforms is a plus. Knowledge of AI search, LLM optimization, GEO, and/or AI Overviews is strongly preferred. Originally posted on Himalayas

Publishing blogs and conducting a final review. Creating and sending the blog newsletter on a monthly basis. Structuring content using answer-engine-friendly formatting (e.g. direct answers, concise takeaways, FAQ sections, and structured schema) to maximize citations across LLMs and AI search engines. Updating existing blogs - with recent data, stats/facts, examples, product information, title image, and for AEO/SEO optimization Conducting ongoing AEO and AIO analysis and experimentation to drive brand recommendations and visibility in AI-driven search environments. Writing product-based blogs for new launches Working on email marketing content & banner content for new launches Building email campaigns on Active Campaign and scheduling these Working with the Tech team to collect customer data for email campaigns Identifying and applying new trends of AEO/SEO. Understanding of Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and AI Optimization (AIO) concepts, including structuring content for LLM visibility and search citations. Familiarity with SEO, what makes great content, updated best practices and the ability to optimize content accordingly. Excellent time management skills and ability to meet tight deadlines without compromising quality. Strong communication skills and ability to provide constructive feedback to writers. Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. Experience working in a fast-paced environment, prioritizing tasks efficiently. observations.description: Buscamos un Marketing Operations Specialist para integrarse al equipo de Mediam Group en Panamá. Esta posición es responsable de la ejecución y optimización de las principales herramientas, canales y procesos de marketing de la compañía: desde campañas de email y automatización, hasta la gestión web, SEO, webinars y Social Media corporativo. El perfil ideal es una persona organizada, resolutiva y con fuerte orientación digital, capaz de conectar herramientas, contenidos y procesos para garantizar una operación consistente y medible en los distintos mercados de Mediam. No requiere ser diseñadora ni desarrolladora, pero sí debe actuar con autonomía, detectar errores, coordinar soluciones y mejorar continuamente la operación. Ubicación: Panamá Modalidad: Remoto Responsabilidades principales 1. CRM, email marketing y automatización Administrar y mantener actualizadas las bases de datos de prospectos, clientes y contactos, con configuraciones básicas en Zoho CRM. Gestionar campañas de email marketing en Brevo: segmentación, configuración, pruebas, programación y envío. Diseñar e implementar flujos automatizados de correo para campañas, eventos, nurturing y seguimiento comercial. Supervisar la entregabilidad y analizar tasas de apertura, clics, conversiones y bajas. Detectar oportunidades para mejorar la calidad de los datos y la efectividad de las comunicaciones. 2. Eventos digitales y webinars Configurar y administrar webinars y eventos digitales en Zoom Webinar. Crear formularios de registro y comunicaciones de confirmación, recordatorio y seguimiento. Coordinar pruebas técnicas con speakers y equipos internos, y brindar soporte durante las transmisiones. Integrar el proceso de registro y seguimiento con Brevo, formularios y landing pages. Preparar reportes de registros, asistencia, engagement y resultados posteriores al evento. 3. Página web y proyectos digitales Actualizar contenidos, imágenes, formularios y páginas dentro de WordPress. Crear y administrar landing pages en Unbounce u herramientas similares. Coordinar mejoras y nuevos proyectos web con diseñadores, desarrolladores y proveedores externos. Interpretar diseños y prototipos en Figma para acompañar y validar su implementación. Realizar controles de calidad antes de publicar páginas, formularios o campañas, y dar seguimiento a errores con los equipos correspondientes. 4. SEO y analítica Aplicar buenas prácticas de SEO on-page en páginas, artículos y landing pages. Optimizar títulos, metadescripciones, estructura de contenidos, enlaces e imágenes. Realizar búsquedas básicas de palabras clave e identificar oportunidades de contenido. Monitorear el desempeño orgánico del sitio y coordinar mejoras técnicas cuando sea necesario. Preparar reportes periódicos con aprendizajes y recomendaciones accionables. 5. Social Media Management Gestionar los canales corporativos de Mediam, principalmente LinkedIn e Instagram. Organizar, actualizar y dar seguimiento al calendario editorial. Programar y publicar contenidos, adaptando copies y formatos a cada plataforma. Coordinar con diseño la producción de piezas gráficas, carruseles, videos y otros contenidos. Monitorear comentarios, interacciones y mensajes, escalando oportunidades relevantes. Analizar alcance, engagement, crecimiento, tráfico y desempeño de las publicaciones. Identificar tendencias, noticias y oportunidades vinculadas con CTV, streaming y publicidad digital. Requisitos técnicos CRM y email marketing: Experiencia práctica con Brevo o plataformas equivalentes; conocimiento deseable de Zoho CRM. Webinars: Manejo de Zoom Webinar para configuración, administración y soporte en eventos digitales. Web y landing pages: Dominio de WordPress y herramientas de landing pages como Unbounce o similares. Diseño y coordinación: Capacidad para interpretar diseños y prototipos en Figma y coordinar su implementación con equipos creativos. SEO on-page: Conocimientos prácticos de optimización: títulos, metadescripciones, estructura de contenidos, enlaces e imágenes. Redes sociales: Experiencia gestionando canales corporativos (LinkedIn e Instagram) con herramientas de programación, análisis y gestión de comunidad. Herramientas adicionales: Canva u otras herramientas básicas de edición de contenido digital. Experiencia requerida Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en marketing digital, marketing operations o posiciones similares. observations.description: Location: Remote – Latin America (Open to applicants located anywhere in the LATAM region) Fueled is a leading digital strategy, design, and engineering agency. We are a 300+ person team that has designed and built hundreds of digital products and experiences for brands like Google, Apple, The New York Times, ESPN, Victoria's Secret, MGM Resorts, Albertsons, and CLEAR. As a Full Stack Web Engineer at Fueled , your mission is to turn well-defined tickets and user stories into clean, production-ready code that powers large-scale digital experiences. Working within enterprise WordPress engagements, you'll build and deliver features end-to-end, from the frontend experience to modern PHP, JavaScript, and Gutenberg blocks in React.js. You'll bring designs and requirements to life within themes and plugins, moving quickly and confidently by pairing your own craft with AI-assisted workflows, thorough documentation, and the support of senior engineers who review and elevate your work. This is a role for engineers who love the craft: you write code you're proud of, you welcome sharp code review, and you treat AI tools as a force multiplier, not a substitute for understanding. You should be comfortable taking a feature from requirements through implementation, making sound decisions along the way, and delivering a polished, production-ready result. Your work will ship to platforms serving millions of visitors, alongside a team recognized as one of the top enterprise WordPress practices in the world. Intentionally remote, our team thrives in a culture that values flexibility, creativity, and cutting-edge technology. For engineers in Latin America, that means real-time collaboration with US-based teams during your normal working day, compensation in USD, and a seat at the table on projects for globally recognized brands – all from wherever you work best. Together, we're shaping the future of digital experiences. What you will do: Build features for enterprise-level WordPress solutions – custom Gutenberg blocks in React.js, plugins, and themes using modern HTML/CSS and well-structured PHP. Own tickets end-to-end: understand the requirements, make sound decisions when details are incomplete, and deliver reviewable pull requests with clear summaries of your approach, assumptions, and testing. Bring designs and user experiences to life by translating Figma designs and other project requirements into polished, responsive features and reusable components within WordPress themes and plugins. Leverage AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow to accelerate implementation and debugging while critically validating every output before it reaches a pull request. Iterate on code review feedback from senior and lead engineers, absorbing patterns and best practices that sharpen your craft with every merge. Collaborate proactively and asynchronously in English with distributed teammates across engineering, design, and delivery. What you will achieve: Within your first month, you'll have shipped merged, production-ready pull requests on a live client project, demonstrating that you can take written direction and run with it. By the 3-month mark, you'll be independently owning tickets from requirement to release, with review cycles getting shorter as your grasp of our conventions deepens. Your AI-assisted workflow will have measurably accelerated delivery on your project – without ever compromising the quality bar our clients expect. You'll have earned the trust of your engineering leads as a dependable contributor whose PRs are a pleasure to review. By the end of your contract, you'll have a portfolio of enterprise-grade work, sharpened skills, and a standing invitation for future collaboration. About you: You have solid agency or consultancy experience building WordPress solutions for large-scale, enterprise projects – high-traffic sites, demanding clients, real deadlines. You're comfortable working across the web stack, including HTML, CSS, modern PHP, JavaScript, and the Gutenberg ecosystem, including building custom blocks with React.js. Bonus points if you've worked with our open-source tools, like ElasticPress or ClassifAI – tell us about it in your application. AI tools are already part of how you work: you use them to move faster, and you know exactly when they're wrong. You're passionate about sharpening your craft – you read best practices for fun, seek out code review, and never ship code you don't understand. You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken, and can confidently walk a reviewer through your decisions, assumptions, and tradeoffs. You're based in Latin America, and thrive on a distributed team, collaborating in real time with US time zones from the remote location of your choice. Contractor Fee Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors including relevant experience, projects, geographic location, and business needs. Contractor fees are paid in USD. Join our Contractor Pool This role is designed as a contract position, offering you the opportunity to experience our team and culture while showcasing your contributions. When the fit and business needs align, some contractors are invited to explore a transition into full-time roles. If you are passionate about Fueled 's mission and think you have what it takes to be successful in this role, even if you don't check all the boxes – please apply. We'd appreciate the opportunity to review your application. Everyone gets a response. Upon meeting the necessary criteria, you'll join the Fueled contractor network, granting you access to project invitations tailored to your expertise and availability when they arise. Any data provided will be processed in accordance with applicable law and our privacy policy. Curious about what to expect during our talent process? Check it out here. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: WordPress doesn’t try to keep its users inside walled gardens, a rare thing in a world that is dangerously moving away from the open web. Instead, WordPress gives them the freedom to build a business website, an online store, or a personal blog – the way they like it. Big sites or small, using the community-run open source project or Automattic ’s , vanilla or customized with hundreds of plugins, WordPress users always get to own and control their data, their expression, and their freedom. We’re always looking for talented and experienced engineers worldwide, excited to help Automattic ’s product ecosystem, and join our mission to make the web a better place. What have we worked on recently? AI is at the heart of many new product developments and powers a lot of our day-to-day development workflows. WooCommerce is the most popular and most flexible e-commerce platform on the web. We're working tirelessly on giving you all the control, while keeping the platform fast and stable. Gutenberg is a new block-level editor for WordPress with clean abstractions for users, too, not just developers. Tumblr is a microblogging social network where users create, share, and follow what they love. To view more of our recent work, check out our longer product list on Automattic .com. How do we work? We’re kind to each other and our users – we build a positive, supportive, and inclusive culture of cohesive teams focused on building useful products for our customers. We work as a global and distributed workforce resulting in a unique way of working built around our creed. We offer flexible work arrangements allowing our team members to work when they feel best. We open-source! We’re cool with open-sourcing everything except passwords, or secret keys. We ship often, deploying many times daily with the help of peer code review, continuous integration, and our global workforce in over 70 countries. We welcome collaboration, and you can be involved in any discussion across our many communication channels. We encourage you to learn and develop and we support you with what you need – covering expenses, easy internal mobility, coaching. Enough about us, let‘s talk more about you. Working at Automattic might be a good fit if: You care and often obsess over the quality and the details of your work. Debugging any problem is a fun challenge and not a chore. Understanding the layers of abstraction below and above your work isn't something extra, but how you operate. You have production experience with several programming languages, frameworks, and paradigms. We mostly use PHP and JavaScript at Automattic , we expect you to be comfortable with the idea of becoming an expert in these languages, even if being one isn't a requirement to apply. In your mind abstraction is associated as much with cost as it is with value. You have experience working at scale – it can be on the backend and performance side, or via the complexity of interacting with a multi-million diverse userbase. Are open and able to travel 3-4 weeks per year to meet up with your teammates in person. These are exciting times at Automattic and you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of our products. Join us! We look forward to hearing from you. Curious who works in engineering at Automattic ? Meet our Code Wranglers – Brandon, Jeremy, Mark, Jennifer, Roy and Kat! What to Expect: We know applying to jobs can be stressful and we want to ease the stress by giving clear expectations upfront about our process. We’ve outlined everything you need to know here including all of the steps in the process as well as how we approach hiring. Please note that we are paying extra attention to your answers to the questions in the application form. They are a significant part of the hiring process, and we will review them just like we would review any other step of the hiring process. We’re always iterating so if you happen to join us in the process, please feel free to offer feedback on what else we can include there! Salary range: $70,000-$170,000 USD. Please note that salary ranges are global, regardless of location, and we pay in local currency. We are searching for high-caliber candidates with the skills and qualities to have a net positive for Automattic . Pay will reflect the potential contribution and the impact you can bring, which may, in some cases, go beyond the range stated. We’re pleased to offer a straightforward, competitive base salary, providing financial clarity without complex variable components. This isn’t your typical work-from-home job: we are a fully-remote company with an open vacation policy. To see a full list of benefits by country, consult our Benefits Page. And check out these links to learn more about How We Hire and What We Expect from Ourselves. observations.description: Pressable (“WordPress hosting that means business”) seeks an experienced, motivated, and empathetic professional with the expertise to help us meet or exceed aggressive growth goals for our superb WordPress hosting company, part of the Automattic family. Collaboration: Work closely with the senior sales team to ensure smooth handoffs for qualified leads and help drive deals forward. Customer Expansion & Retention: Engage with existing Pressable customers to identify expansion opportunities, support retention efforts, and assist with account-related sales activities, ensuring customers continue to receive sales support and value as their needs evolve. AI-Assisted Sales Execution: Use AI tools to support prospect research, call preparation, follow-up drafting, and deal summarization, ensuring high-quality and timely customer engagement. Signal & Insight Capture: Leverage call transcripts, summaries, and AI-generated insights to identify customer needs, objections, and next steps, and reflect those clearly in the CRM. Feedback Loop Participation: Contribute structured feedback surfaced through AI tools (e.g., call analysis, objection trends) to improve sales playbooks, enablement, and product feedback loops. Own monthly qualified meeting and pipeline generation targets, consistently hitting or exceeding defined conversion and activity benchmarks. Requirements: Excellent Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively interact with prospects and qualify leads. Customer-Focused: A passion for understanding customer needs and offering solutions to help solve their challenges. Self-Motivated: Ability to work independently and manage multiple conversations and tasks at once, ensuring timely follow-ups and outreach. Preferred Qualifications: 2-5 years of experience in a BDR/JDR or similar role. Familiarity with WordPress and managed hosting services. Proven track record of generating leads and setting up successful sales conversations. As a part of our fully distributed team, you can live anywhere in the world. observations.description: The Opportunity Join a growing SaaS-focused organization developing an advanced AI-powered search solution designed specifically for WordPress environments. This role sits at the intersection of outbound sales and content marketing, supporting both product promotion and broader agency services. You’ll work closely with leadership while engaging prospects and contributing to thought leadership in AI and search technology. This is a flexible, part-time opportunity where your work directly drives product adoption and revenue growth. Key Responsibilities Conduct targeted prospecting and outbound outreach across channels, including LinkedIn and cold outreach Identify and research high-potential prospects, particularly content-heavy WordPress sites across key industries Perform “search audits” to evaluate prospect websites and highlight opportunities for improvement Create and share personalized outreach assets, including short-form Loom videos demonstrating product value Manage and support social media activity, including drafting and coordinating LinkedIn content Assist with appointment setting and coordinating product demo opportunities Support content and sales collateral development, including case studies, decks, and marketing materials Compensation Competitive monthly compensation based on experience and role scope. Monthly compensation ranges from ₱32,000 – ₱42,000 , depending on experience and role scope. Final compensation is aligned with the candidate’s experience level. Required Skills Core Technical Skills Required Sales development and outbound prospecting Cold calling and outreach strategy execution Social media management (LinkedIn-focused) Content creation and coordination Experience using Google Workspace and WordPress Professional Skills Required Client-facing professionalism Strong attention to detail Candidate Fit Productive and persistent professionals who can manage outreach with consistency Detail-oriented individuals who can balance research, communication, and execution Candidates comfortable working across both sales and content-driven initiatives Professional Readiness Candidates applying for this role should have a reliable home office setup, stable internet connection, and the ability to maintain consistent availability during the required working hours. Successful candidates communicate proactively, meet deadlines, and take ownership of responsibilities while working remotely. About Our Client Our client operates in the SaaS and software space, specializing in AI-powered search solutions built for WordPress environments. Their product leverages retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) technology to deliver accurate, citation-backed search experiences using client-owned data. In addition to their product offering, they also support web development and digital strategy initiatives across multiple industries. Application Process If you meet the requirements outlined above and are interested in this opportunity, please complete our quick application form by uploading your resume and submitting a short 1-minute introduction video. observations.description: About us: At Remote Talent LATAM , we connect top Latin American talent with leading U.S. marketing agencies. We guide businesses and candidates through every step of the hiring process, ensuring the perfect match in skills, culture, and goals. While we’re not direct employers, we act as a trusted partner, bridging the gap between exceptional talent and growing opportunities Our Client: Our client is a fast-growing digital marketing agency specializing in helping medical aesthetics practices, med spas, dermatologists, plastic surgeons, and other healthcare providers grow their businesses through patient acquisition and revenue-focused marketing strategies. Their approach combines paid advertising, lead generation, conversion optimization, SEO, websites, email/SMS marketing, and strategic consulting to help practices attract qualified patients and fill their schedules. What you will do: We are seeking a Website & SEO Project Manager who will oversee the delivery of new website builds and ongoing website updates while managing a team of professionals, including designers, developers, and copywriters. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong project and resource management skills with client relationship expertise. You should be comfortable coordinating cross-functional teams, managing multiple priorities, identifying potential issues, and taking ownership of project outcomes. Responsabilities: Team & Resource Management: Lead and coordinate a team of designers, developers, and copywriters. Allocate resources effectively across website builds, redesigns, and ongoing website updates. Coordinate with the SEO team and other internal departments to ensure alignment on project priorities and deliverables. Monitor team capacity, identify resource constraints, and proactively address potential bottlenecks. Support smooth collaboration and handoffs between departments. Website Project Management: Own the end-to-end delivery of new website builds, redesigns, and ongoing website updates. Manage multiple website projects simultaneously, ensuring timelines, milestones, and deliverables remain on track. Develop and maintain detailed project plans, deadlines, and task dependencies. Track project progress and team workflows using ClickUp. Ensure website projects meet established quality standards throughout the project lifecycle. Identify risks, resolve blockers, and escalate challenges with proposed solutions. Maintain accurate project documentation, decisions, and client feedback. Client Communication & Relationship Management: Serve as a key point of contact for assigned website clients. Manage client onboarding, discovery calls, project updates, and issue resolution. Communicate project timelines, progress, and potential delays proactively. Build trust with clients through clear, empathetic, and consistent communication. Translate website development and SEO-related concepts into accessible language. Manage client expectations and ensure concerns are addressed promptly. Maintain a high standard of client satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle. Process & Workflow Optimization: Leverage ClickUp workflows, automations, custom fields, and views to improve project visibility and efficiency. Identify opportunities to improve project delivery processes and team collaboration. Ensure smooth handoffs between SEO, design, development, and content teams. Develop and maintain organized workflows and documentation. Contribute to standardized processes and best practices for website project management. Requirements 3+ years of experience in project management, website management, or digital marketing agency operations. Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, with experience in highly client-facing roles. Proven experience managing multiple website projects, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously. Strong project and resource management experience. Experience leading teams and coordinating cross-functional resources. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through. Experience working with website projects, preferably within an agency environment. Understanding of website development processes and SEO fundamentals. Ability to proactively identify and resolve issues while taking ownership of project outcomes. Ability to work independently, manage changing priorities, and communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders. Tools & Technical Experience: ClickUp: Experience with project management workflows, task dependencies, automations, custom fields, and views is preferred. WordPress: Familiarity with WordPress is important for effectively managing website projects; deep technical expertise is not required. Zyflow: Experience with website proofing and client feedback tools is a plus. (Not mandatory) Project Management Methodologies: Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, or similar methodologies is beneficial but not mandatory. Website Development: Understanding of the website design, development, content, and review process. Core Competencies We Value: Exceptional Communication: You communicate clearly, proactively, and professionally with clients and internal teams. Leadership & Resource Management: You coordinate people and resources effectively to deliver successful projects. Accountability: You take ownership of commitments, project outcomes, and client satisfaction. Proactive Problem-Solving: You anticipate challenges and develop solutions before issues escalate. Organization & Attention to Detail: You manage multiple projects and priorities without losing track of important details. Empathy: You understand client concerns and build trust through thoughtful communication. Adaptability: You thrive in a fast-paced agency environment with evolving priorities. Benefits Full-time position, Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST. Salary: 4,500 USD Monthly (Open to negotiation based on experience) Location: 100% remote, open to candidates based in LATAM Contract: Independent Contractor PTO: 2 weeks of paid time off + 1 week of sick leave annually. This position is only open to candidates residing in Latin American (LATAM) countries, such as: 🇦🇷 🇧🇷 🇨🇱 🇨🇴 🇨🇷 🇩🇴 🇪🇨 🇸🇻 🇬🇹 🇭🇳 🇲🇽 🇳🇮 🇵🇦 🇵🇾 🇵🇪 🇺🇾 🇻🇪 ❌ Applications from candidates outside LATAM (including the U.S. and other regions) will not be considered. 📄 Resumes must be submitted in English. 🚫 Applications that do not meet these criteria will be automatically rejected Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: This is a remote position. Rockstar is hiring a full-time Marketing & Social Media Virtual Assistant on behalf of a multi-location outpatient physical therapy practice looking to bring consistency and ownership back to their marketing after going without a dedicated marketing person for some time. The core of this role is being the practice's steady marketing engine: owning social media across all channels, creating on-brand content in Canva, and keeping the WordPress website and blog section current and polished. Beyond that, the VA will support email campaigns, event and swag coordination, online review monitoring, and monthly performance reporting, and will also take on executive assistant tasks directed through the practice's Office Manager, things like inbox and calendar management, travel coordination, and document prep. This role calls for someone who can take a task from start to finish with minimal hand-holding and strong attention to brand detail, previous marketing hires have struggled with inconsistent branding and spelling errors, and this practice needs someone who catches those things before they go out, not after. About the Client This multi-location outpatient physical therapy practice is built on high personal integrity, a well-trained and committed team, and evidence-based, patient-first care. They run on a Scaling Up operating model with clear functions, documented processes, and accountability to KPIs, and they're actively strengthening their systems as they grow. The practice values proactive ownership, discretion, and someone who documents their own processes. They're rebuilding their admin and leadership structure after some recent transitions, and they want this hire to take real work off their plate rather than add oversight burden. Key Responsibilities Primary Responsibilities Own and manage all social media channels, posting consistently and following established brand guidelines Create on-brand content and visuals in Canva Maintain and update the WordPress website, including adding new therapists as they're hired Collect blogs from therapists, edit for readability, add images, and publish to the website Monitor online reviews and respond appropriately Secondary Responsibilities Manage patient reactivation email campaigns through Second Door Coordinate marketing and referral-source events, including scheduling, food orders, and branded swag Support Google Ads/SEO coordination through the practice's website vendor Produce a monthly analytics report covering impressions, follower growth, and channel trends Support onboarding content uploads into the practice's LMS (Clinical Marketer) as time allows Executive Assistant Support (directed through the Office Manager) Manage inbox and calendar triage-to-execution Handle scheduling, correspondence, and meeting prep Coordinate travel and conference logistics Support document formatting and file/drive organization Track follow-ups and flag items that need a decision Tools & Systems Canva WordPress Second Door Google Workspace (Google Chat, Drive) Trello Weave Requirements Prior marketing or social media management experience required Strong understanding of brand consistency and attention to detail, spelling and formatting errors are not acceptable Comfortable using AI tools to work efficiently across content creation and planning WordPress experience strongly preferred Self-directed with strong follow-through, comfortable taking ownership of a task without needing frequent check-ins Portfolio of previous marketing or content work required for review Non-Negotiables HIPAA compliance and absolute discretion with patient and business information Reliable and responsive during agreed Central-time core business hours, proactive communication, no ghosting Strong ownership and follow-through, takes tasks to completion with minimal hand-holding and flags anything that needs a decision Benefits Competitive salary commensurate with experience. Opportunities for professional development and growth. Work in a dynamic and supportive team environment. Make a meaningful impact by helping to build and strengthen families across the Globe Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: In this volunteer position we are looking for someone who is skilled with using Reallusion's Character Creator 3 (CC3) for creating realistic 3D Character Body, Face and Hair Meshes and within the software. We would also expect you to be able to create your own 2D Textures as well as be able to import/export your CC3 Creations to Epic Games' Unreal Engine 4 . These 3D Characters would be used in our game "The Lays of Althas: Sundered Order" (LoA:SO). If necessary, you can be provided with provided the necessary software for the work you'll be required. Communication is key to a smooth and efficient pipeline. You must be able to communicate clearly and effectively with other team-members and not be afraid to ask should any problems arise. We are an English-speaking team, so English fluency is a must. If you are comfortable with teaching, you may be called upon to aid the more junior members of the team in any relevant area. Required Software: Epic Games' Unreal Engine 4: Reallusion's Character Creator 3 (CC3): Adobe Photoshop, GIMP or similar for creating high-quality 2D Textures. observations.description: ★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★ Operations & Executive Assistant Location: Remote — Latin America Work Arrangement: Fully Remote Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor Industry: Professional Services / Consulting Compensation: $1,800 – $2,200 USD/month English Proficiency: Professional written and spoken English required Schedule: Full-Time | Meaningful overlap with U.S. Pacific Time business hours About the Company Our client is a small U.S.-based consultancy that helps founders and marketing teams organize knowledge, processes, and AI-enabled workflows. The team is lean and distributed, with Notion as its central operational hub and AI tools used to improve research, documentation, and execution. About the Role We are looking for a proactive Operations & Executive Assistant to keep projects, systems, and recurring responsibilities moving forward. This is primarily an operations role . You will manage workflows in Notion, coordinate deadlines, maintain CRM and documentation, follow up with team members and contractors, and make sure operational details do not fall through the cracks. You must already be comfortable using Notion and AI tools in your day-to-day work . We value people who can independently prioritize, identify blockers, research solutions, and take the next reasonable action without waiting for detailed instructions. Why This Opportunity? This role offers the opportunity to work directly with a U.S.-based founder while taking meaningful ownership of day-to-day operations, systems, and workflows. You'll work hands-on with Notion, AI, project coordination, CRM, and process improvement , with the autonomy to help build better operational systems rather than simply execute a static administrative checklist. What You'll Do Manage projects, tasks, owners, due dates, dependencies, and recurring workflows in Notion . Review overdue tasks, missing owners, unanswered requests, and stalled projects, following up proactively to keep work moving. Turn disorganized requests into clear next actions and prepare concise updates on priorities, risks, blockers, and decisions needed. Maintain Notion databases, CRM records, SOPs, internal documentation, and Google Drive resources . Use AI tools for research, synthesis, documentation, meeting preparation, summaries, SOP creation, drafting, and routine operational support, validating outputs before use. Identify opportunities to simplify, document, or improve recurring processes using Notion, AI, and better workflows. Track executive commitments, approvals, follow-ups, and decisions; prepare agendas and convert meeting decisions into assigned tasks and deadlines. Coordinate contractor onboarding, access, invoices, time logs, subscriptions, renewals, and basic administrative logistics. Research vendors, tools, services, and operational questions and recommend practical next steps. Support lightweight marketing operations such as scheduling approved content and uploading website, email, or social content when needed. Qualifications Required Qualifications Experience in operations, project coordination, executive support, or a similar operational role . Hands-on Notion experience with databases, tasks/projects, templates, properties, views, and filters. Professional experience using AI tools in daily workflows for research, synthesis, documentation, drafting, or operational support. Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, recurring responsibilities, and CRM/project-management systems. Strong organization, prioritization, attention to detail, and follow-through. Ability to independently research problems, propose practical solutions, and adjust as priorities change. Professional written and spoken English. Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting a founder, executive, or small professional-services business. Experience reorganizing messy operational systems, maintaining SOPs, or improving recurring workflows. Experience using AI to streamline recurring processes or administrative work. Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, WordPress , or similar business tools. Basic marketing operations or content scheduling experience. How Success Is Measured Success means projects and recurring responsibilities move forward without constant founder oversight; Notion and CRM remain organized and reliable ; deadlines and blockers are proactively managed; and operational problems are surfaced with context and a proposed solution. You will also help simplify or improve recurring processes using Notion, AI, and stronger operational workflows . Why Join Us? $1,800 – $2,200 USD/month . Fully remote work in Latin America. Direct exposure to the founder with significant autonomy and ownership. Hands-on work with Notion, AI, systems, and process improvement . Opportunity to build better operational systems rather than simply execute a static administrative checklist. Important Notes This is an operations-first position , not a traditional calendar-focused Executive Assistant role. Candidates must already have practical Notion experience and professional experience using AI tools in their day-to-day work . We are looking for someone who can organize complexity, close loops, follow up confidently, and solve problems without constant supervision. This is a remote/telecommute position. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Who Are We? JayWay Travel is approaching its 20th anniversary and has grown into an international travel company with a team of 100+ people across more than 20 countries. We create personalized travel experiences across Europe, Latin America, and other destinations , helping travelers turn their ideas into memorable journeys. Our team brings together travel enthusiasts, marketers, sales professionals, planners, and problem-solvers — all working toward creating great experiences for our guests. Are You a Marketing Professional Who Likes to Get Things Done? We’re looking for an experienced marketing professional who understands brands, enjoys working with people, and is comfortable taking an idea and figuring out how to make it happen. This is a broad, cross-functional role covering areas such as brand, guest experience, partnerships, and marketing operations. You’ll work closely with the Head of Department and with teams across JayWay to keep projects moving, spot opportunities, and make sure the way we present and deliver JayWay feels consistent. No two days will necessarily look the same — and that’s part of the appeal. And don’t worry if you don’t tick every box or have experience in every area listed. We’re interested in how you think, how you approach challenges, and how you turn ideas into action. What Will You Do? Help manage the JayWay brand across our marketing and guest-facing communications, keeping our voice, messaging, and visual identity consistent. Look at the guest experience across different touchpoints, using feedback, reviews, and other insights to identify what’s working and where we can improve. Research and help develop new partnerships and commercial opportunities that could add value for our guests and our business. Coordinate projects involving internal teams, agencies, freelancers, designers, creators, and other external partners. Keep marketing projects organized, including timelines, budgets, vendors, tools, and documentation . Maintain and improve brand guidelines, templates, processes, and other resources used by the wider team. Keep an eye on industry trends, guest expectations, competitors, and new opportunities , and bring useful ideas to the Head of Department. Help make sure projects are delivered on time, to a high standard, and in a way that feels right for JayWay. What Makes You a Great Fit? You’ve already spent a few years working in marketing or a related field and are comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do. We’d expect you to have: 3+ years of experience in brand management, integrated marketing, communications, guest/customer experience, partnerships, business development, marketing operations, or a related area. Strong communication skills and the confidence to work with people across different teams and levels of the organization. Good commercial instincts and an understanding of what makes something valuable for both the customer and the business. Excellent organization and attention to detail — especially when several projects are happening at once. The ability to work with both creative ideas and practical details , from a campaign concept to a budget, deadline, vendor, or approval. An analytical mindset and the ability to turn feedback, data, and research into useful recommendations. A proactive approach. If you see something that could be better, you’re the kind of person who will raise it and help find a solution. Experience in travel, hospitality, tourism, luxury, lifestyle, destination marketing, or another high-touch service business is a plus, but it’s not essential. Tools & Platforms You should be comfortable learning and working with a range of tools. Experience with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Milanote, WordPress, ClickUp, Muck Rack , or similar marketing and project-management platforms is a plus. Why You’ll Love Working With Us Competitive pay & performance bonuses that recognize your impact. Remote-first flexibility , with the opportunity to collaborate across 20+ countries. Annual all-company gatherings in breathtaking European locations. Full support with work-from-home setup and equipment . Wellness programs and travel insurance . Covered travel expenses for business-related trips. Our Hiring Process We believe in human-led recruitment — no AI filters. Here’s what you can expect: Short one-way video questionnaire to learn more about your background. Initial video interview with our HR team. Job-related task to see how you approach the work. Interview with our executive marketing team. We’ll review your application personally and aim to keep the process straightforward and respectful of your time. Ready to Join Us? If you have solid marketing experience, enjoy working across different areas, and like being the person who spots an opportunity and figures out what to do with it, we’d love to hear from you. You don’t need to have done everything listed above. What matters is that you’re curious, capable, organized, commercially aware, and comfortable taking ownership. Think this sounds like you? Apply now. Please submit your CV in English to get started. We’re looking forward to hearing from you. 👉 Explore JayWay’s story JayWay Travel Inc. is committed to ensuring equal opportunities, with recruitment and selection decisions based solely on qualifications and merit, without regard to protected characteristics. observations.description: At EverCommerce [Nasdaq: EVCM], we are on a mission to digitally transform the service economy with tailored, end-to-end SaaS solutions that simplify and empower the lives of our 745,000+ customers. As a leading service commerce platform, our modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals in the areas of Home & Field Services, Health Services, and Wellness industries. We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: EverPro, a business within EverCommerce , provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth. Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses. Position Summary The Web Developer II is an experienced individual contributor responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing the marketing websites across EverCommerce 's portfolio of SaaS products. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role owns end-to-end execution of web projects — from CMS configuration and front-end implementation to performance optimization and QA — while serving as a collaborative partner to the broader Marketing, SEO/AEO/GEO, and Design functions. This role sits within the Marketing organization under the Manager, Web Development. Web Developer II is expected to drive measurable impact on site health, page speed, and conversion infrastructure across a multi-product, multi-domain environment. Qualifications Required 2–5 years of professional web development experience, with a portfolio demonstrating marketing site or SaaS product site work. Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (vanilla JS; React & Next.js familiarity a plus). Object-oriented PHP (Laravel a plus). Hands-on CMS experience with at least one major platform (WordPress, Webflow, HubSpot CMS, or equivalent) including custom theme/template development. Working knowledge of responsive design principles and cross-browser testing methodologies. Familiarity with Core Web Vitals measurement, on-page performance optimization techniques, and the unique challenges of optimizing marketing sites where third-party scripts, CMS templates, and campaign launches constantly push against page speed. Experience with Google Tag Manager, GA4, and conversion tracking implementation. Version control proficiency using Git (branching, pull requests, merge workflows). Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical marketing stakeholders. Preferred Experience in a multi-product or multi-brand SaaS marketing environment. Familiarity with technical SEO implementation including schema markup, structured data, and AEO/GEO content formatting. Exposure to A/B testing and conversion rate optimization frameworks. Understanding of marketing funnels, attribution models, and how web, analytics, CRM, and ad platforms connect end-to-end. Knowledge of WCAG accessibility standards. Experience working alongside an external agency or offshore development partner. Familiarity with AWS, Cloudflare, or comparable cloud/CDN infrastructure. Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub, Claude Code) to accelerate development velocity, generate boilerplate, and debug complex front-end issues. Familiarity with AI-native web tooling — including LLM-powered CMS and generative UI prototyping tools. A demonstrated curiosity about integrating these capabilities into a marketing web workflow. Working knowledge of what makes web content LLM-consumable: structured data, schema concise and authoritative prose patterns, and technical configurations that enable AI crawlers to surface site content in AI-generated search responses. Front-End Development & CMS Management Build, update, and maintain marketing landing pages and site sections across multiple product domains using CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress, Webflow, or equivalent). Write clean, semantic HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript to implement designs with pixel-level accuracy and cross-browser compatibility. Configure and extend CMS themes, templates, custom page builders, and reusable component libraries. Implement and maintain responsive design patterns optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints. Site Performance & Technical Optimization Own Core Web Vitals performance metrics (LCP, INP, CLS) across all product marketing sites, proactively identifying and resolving issues. Implement image optimization, lazy loading, script deferral, CDN configuration, and caching strategies to drive measurable page speed improvements. Execute technical SEO and AEO/GEO site-readiness requirements including schema markup (JSON-LD), meta tags, canonical tags, hreflang, and XML sitemaps. Ensure AI bot crawl accessibility (Googlebot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) by verifying robots.txt configurations, crawl permissions, and LLM-consumability of site content. Monitor site health via platforms such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, or similar tools and surface issues to the organic growth team. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Support Implement A/B and multivariate tests using experimentation platforms (e.g., Google Optimize, VWO, or equivalent), following a structured test-and-learn framework. Support AI-referred CRO initiatives by building and testing landing page variants optimized for intent signals from AI-referred traffic sources. Configure and maintain tracking infrastructure including GTM tag deployment, GA4 event schemas, and conversion pixel integration across paid and organic channels. Partner with Paid Media and Organic Growth teams to build and QA campaign-specific landing pages, ensuring correct UTM parameter capture and downstream attribution. Web Infrastructure & Governance Maintain web development documentation including site maps, URL redirect logs, A/B test registers, and deployment runbooks. Manage staging, UAT, and production deployment workflows using version control (Git) and maintain organized branching conventions. Support the implementation of a human-in-the-loop web deployment approval process, coordinating review steps with the Marketing Leadership Team as scoped. Ensure WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance across all new and updated pages. Monitor and maintain SSL certificates, domain configurations, and third-party script governance. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with agency partners and internal stakeholders to standardize web deployment workflows and documentation. Act as a key implementation partner for SEO, AEO/GEO, and CRO initiatives originating from the Organic Growth and Paid Media teams, in coordination with the Manager, Web Development. Partner with product marketing and brand teams to ensure new campaign launches are fully integrated with the site infrastructure on time and on spec. Provide technical scoping estimates for incoming web requests, contributing input to roadmap discussions led by the Manager, Web Development. Ways to Work & Team Posture Operates effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift to meet business needs, re-sequencing work without losing momentum. Takes initiative to surface ideas, opportunities, and improvements that benefit Marketing and partner functions across the organization. Brings a team-first mindset, shares context generously, pairs with peers and the agency partner to unblock work, and contributes beyond the strict scope of assigned tickets. Communicates trade-offs clearly when priorities collide, recommending a path forward rather than waiting for direction. Communicates technical problems and recommendations in plain language so non-technical partners understand the impact, the options, and what's being asked of them. Thinks forward as web technologies, AI tooling, and the broader martech landscape evolve making implementation choices today that hold up tomorrow rather than optimizing only for the immediate ask. Where: Remote, US The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America. Benefits and Perks : Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid Continued investment in your professional development Day 1 robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off Employee Stock Purchase Program Compensation: The target base compensation for this position is $75,000 - $80,000 per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above. EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience! EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Employees remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Please note, this role can be remote or hybird, subject to location This role is a 12 Month Fixed Term Contract As a Marketing Manager, you'll need to: Key Responsibilities Campaign Management & Demand Generation Plan, run, and optimise integrated lead and demand generation campaigns across both Government and Social Housing sectorsthat drive demand and support revenue targets for customer acquisition and expansion. Lead multi-channel campaigns across email, media, website, events, search, paid media and social. Use data to track and optimise MQL > SQL performance. Organise and attend in-person and online events to promote key message narratives. Digital and Website Performance Own and deliver the website strategy to increase traffic, engagement and conversion (WordPress experience a bonus). Improve user journeys and ensure content supports priority initiatives across both the Government and Social Housing. Monitor and analyse website analytics using GA4 and Semrush to identify improvements and report progress. Ensure every web asset has a clear purpose and supports the wider marketing strategy. Manage sector LinkedIn activity Report on digital marketing activity to identify areas for improvement Content and Thought Leadership Develop compelling content that positions NEC as the supplier of choice for councils and housing organisations. Produce or work with external agencies to articles, blogs, case studies, sales enablement tools, whitepapers, guides, and campaign assets. Craft messaging for key initiatives, product propositions, and sector-wide challenges. Maintain consistent tone of voice and ensure alignment across all channels. Team Leadership and Coaching Line-manage and coach a growing team of digital, content, and campaign implementers. Provide clear direction, feedback, and development opportunities. Promote a collaborative, supportive, and high-performance culture. Stakeholder Management Work closely with Product, Sales, Leadership, and subject matter experts to shape initiatives. Translate stakeholder requirements into actionable marketing plans, aligned to the business strategy. Communicate campaign progress and performance against KPIs to senior leadership. Lead external agencies, when appropriate, to effectively manage events, press relationships, editorial requests, design and digital marketing. Reporting, Insights and Automation Monitor and track activity and deliver regular reporting on KPIs. Analyse campaign and website data to recommend improvements. Conduct quantitative and qualitative market and competitor research to support strategy development and campaign activity. Use marketing automation tools (e.g. ActiveCampaign) to build workflows, nurture programmes, and lead scoring. Ensure data quality and reporting accuracy across CRM and marketing systems. And with support, you'll need to: Support the development and implementation of the marketing and communications strategy for wider NECSWS with a particular focus on the government and social housing sectors. Manage stakeholders' expectations. Track marketing performance and return on investment and prepare monthly reports for management. Who are we looking for: The ideal candidate is a creative, digitally savvy and commercially minded marketing professional who can develop compelling content, deliver integrated marketing campaigns, and help position NEC as a trusted partner within Government & Housing. This is a hands-on role, requiring someone who is comfortable creating content, developing campaigns, managing stakeholders, and delivering activity across multiple channels. They will combine strong marketing instincts with a data-driven mindset, using insight and performance metrics to continually improve results. Confident using a range of digital marketing tools and platforms, they will bring a strong understanding of content marketing, social media, website management, email marketing and campaign execution. Essential Experienced Marketing Manager. Self-starter who takes ownership. Proven experience in digital marketing and website optimisation. Strong content creation skills and understanding of messaging for complex sectors. Demonstrable experience delivering integrated lead and demand generation strategies. Experience managing or coaching a small team. Confident using analytics platforms and marketing automation systems. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills at all levels. Data-driven mindset with a focus on results, demonstrating success at improving ROI. Desirable Experience in B2B technology marketing. Knowledge of UK Local Government and/or Social Housing. Understanding of Local Government Reorganisation and sector transformation programmes. Experience running Account Based Marketing programmes. Personal Attributes Highly organised, proactive, and able to manage multiple deadlines. Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach. Able to influence others and build strong working relationships. Passionate about quality, marketing effectiveness, reporting and measurable outcomes. We pride ourselves in offering an excellent benefits package, including an above average pension scheme. When you join the team at NEC Software Solutions, you are provided with the following: Private Medical Cover funded by NEC for Employees (with the option to add family members at an additional cost) 25 days paid holiday with the option to buy/sell 4 x basic salary life assurance cover funded by NEC (with the option to increase cover at an additional cost) A Group Pension Plan with fantastic employer contributions up to a maximum of 8.5% A selection of flexible benefits to suit your individual needs Candidates must be able to demonstrate a pre-existing right to work and travel within the UK. Documentary evidence will be required. All offers are subject to satisfactory vetting and reference checks. Depending on the nature of the role a Disclosure Barring Service (DBS) check may also be required. NEC Software Solutions is an equal opportunities employer, welcoming applications from all communities. If you require any reasonable adjustments or have specific accessibility needs during the recruitment or interview process, please feel free to share these with us. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accommodating experience for all candidates. Who we are? We’re NEC Software Solutions (part of global tech giant NEC Corporation). While you read this ad, our software is helping to dispatch ambulances, support families, keep trains on the move, locate missing people and even test the hearing of newborn babies. Working with us, you’ll be helping our 3,000+ employees push the boundaries of what’s possible and support amazing public services. We work with governments, hospitals, police forces, housing providers, local authorities and more. We help them pay financial support faster, speed up treatments for patients and respond to emergencies in the right way. The more we do, the more our customers can do for others. And together, we make a world of difference. We’d love your help. And we’ll support you all the way. Come join us and make a difference in the world! Discover more at NO AGENCIES PLEASE Originally posted on Himalayas
