observations.description: ★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★ Operations & Executive Assistant Location: Remote — Latin America Work Arrangement: Fully Remote Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor Industry: Professional Services / Consulting Compensation: $1,800 – $2,200 USD/month English Proficiency: Professional written and spoken English required Schedule: Full-Time | Meaningful overlap with U.S. Pacific Time business hours About the Company Our client is a small U.S.-based consultancy that helps founders and marketing teams organize knowledge, processes, and AI-enabled workflows. The team is lean and distributed, with Notion as its central operational hub and AI tools used to improve research, documentation, and execution. About the Role We are looking for a proactive Operations & Executive Assistant to keep projects, systems, and recurring responsibilities moving forward. This is primarily an operations role . You will manage workflows in Notion, coordinate deadlines, maintain CRM and documentation, follow up with team members and contractors, and make sure operational details do not fall through the cracks. You must already be comfortable using Notion and AI tools in your day-to-day work . We value people who can independently prioritize, identify blockers, research solutions, and take the next reasonable action without waiting for detailed instructions. Why This Opportunity? This role offers the opportunity to work directly with a U.S.-based founder while taking meaningful ownership of day-to-day operations, systems, and workflows. You'll work hands-on with Notion, AI, project coordination, CRM, and process improvement , with the autonomy to help build better operational systems rather than simply execute a static administrative checklist. What You'll Do Manage projects, tasks, owners, due dates, dependencies, and recurring workflows in Notion . Review overdue tasks, missing owners, unanswered requests, and stalled projects, following up proactively to keep work moving. Turn disorganized requests into clear next actions and prepare concise updates on priorities, risks, blockers, and decisions needed. Maintain Notion databases, CRM records, SOPs, internal documentation, and Google Drive resources . Use AI tools for research, synthesis, documentation, meeting preparation, summaries, SOP creation, drafting, and routine operational support, validating outputs before use. Identify opportunities to simplify, document, or improve recurring processes using Notion, AI, and better workflows. Track executive commitments, approvals, follow-ups, and decisions; prepare agendas and convert meeting decisions into assigned tasks and deadlines. Coordinate contractor onboarding, access, invoices, time logs, subscriptions, renewals, and basic administrative logistics. Research vendors, tools, services, and operational questions and recommend practical next steps. Support lightweight marketing operations such as scheduling approved content and uploading website, email, or social content when needed. Qualifications Required Qualifications Experience in operations, project coordination, executive support, or a similar operational role . Hands-on Notion experience with databases, tasks/projects, templates, properties, views, and filters. Professional experience using AI tools in daily workflows for research, synthesis, documentation, drafting, or operational support. Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, recurring responsibilities, and CRM/project-management systems. Strong organization, prioritization, attention to detail, and follow-through. Ability to independently research problems, propose practical solutions, and adjust as priorities change. Professional written and spoken English. Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting a founder, executive, or small professional-services business. Experience reorganizing messy operational systems, maintaining SOPs, or improving recurring workflows. Experience using AI to streamline recurring processes or administrative work. Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, WordPress , or similar business tools. Basic marketing operations or content scheduling experience. How Success Is Measured Success means projects and recurring responsibilities move forward without constant founder oversight; Notion and CRM remain organized and reliable ; deadlines and blockers are proactively managed; and operational problems are surfaced with context and a proposed solution. You will also help simplify or improve recurring processes using Notion, AI, and stronger operational workflows . Why Join Us? $1,800 – $2,200 USD/month . Fully remote work in Latin America. Direct exposure to the founder with significant autonomy and ownership. Hands-on work with Notion, AI, systems, and process improvement . Opportunity to build better operational systems rather than simply execute a static administrative checklist. Important Notes This is an operations-first position , not a traditional calendar-focused Executive Assistant role. Candidates must already have practical Notion experience and professional experience using AI tools in their day-to-day work . We are looking for someone who can organize complexity, close loops, follow up confidently, and solve problems without constant supervision. This is a remote/telecommute position. observations.description: Position: Marketing Specialist (B2B) Position Type: Full-time, Permanent (Existing Vacancy) Reports to: Senior Manager, B2B Marketing Location: Toronto, ON (Remote) Division: Postmedia Integrated Advertising The Company: Postmedia is a Canadian news media company representing more than 110 brands across multiple print, online and mobile platforms. Award-winning journalists and innovative product development teams bring engaging content to millions of people every week whenever and wherever they want it. This exceptional content, reach and scope offer advertisers and marketers compelling solutions to effectively reach target audiences. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team. The Opportunity: We are looking for a Marketing Specialist (B2B) who will play a key role in supporting Postmedia’s SMB and National Agency marketing priorities. Working closely with the Content Marketing Specialist, Graphic Artist, Sales, and other stakeholders, you will help bring the Postmedia Solutions brand and go-to-market strategy to life across our owned digital channels, websites, social media platforms, and lead generation campaigns. This role is ideal for a hands-on marketer who understands how to take core content and transform it into targeted, multi-channel marketing assets that drive awareness, engagement, and demand. You will be responsible for distributing content created by the Content Marketing Specialist, developing social strategies and posts, creating lead magnets, and building website and landing page content that supports business growth across SMB and National Agency audiences. Our ideal candidate must know how to: Build strong relationships and collaborate with stakeholders across all levels of the organization. Develop and execute marketing plans that support SMB and National Agency sales priorities. Translate long-form content into engaging “liquid content” for different platforms, audiences, and stages of the buyer journey. Create compelling social media content, lead magnets, website pages, and landing pages. Manage multiple projects while maintaining exceptional attention to detail. Balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced environment. Understand how to distribute and promote content across websites, social media, email, and other digital channels. Use performance insights to optimize content, campaigns, and channel strategy. Develop a deep understanding of the market, competition, trends, and customer needs. What you’ll do: Support the execution of marketing strategies for Postmedia’s SMB and National Agency business. Distribute content created by the Content Marketing Specialist across Postmedia websites, social media platforms, newsletters, and other owned channels. Work with the Content Marketing Specialist and Graphic Artist to turn blog posts and long-form content into liquid content such as social posts, short-form copy, infographics, downloadable assets, email content, and promotional materials. Develop and manage social media strategy and posting schedules for assigned business areas. Create and publish social media content that supports awareness, engagement, lead generation, and sales enablement. Build lead magnets such as guides, checklists, tip sheets, one-pagers, and other downloadable resources. Create and update website pages and landing pages that support marketing campaigns, product priorities, and sales initiatives. Ensure website and landing page content is clear, compelling, accurate, and optimized for conversion. Partner with Sales to understand campaign needs, client priorities, and market opportunities. Maintain and apply SEO/AEO/GEO best practices to website, landing page, and campaign content. Support the execution of content calendars in alignment with strategic direction. Ensure all marketing content is on brand and in the proper tone of voice for the target audience. Track, measure, and report on campaign, content, website, landing page, and social media performance. Identify opportunities to improve content distribution, audience engagement, and lead generation. Work within the Postmedia toolset: HubSpot, SEMRush, social publishing tools, WordPress. Who you are: 3+ years’ experience in marketing, digital marketing, social media, content marketing, or a related field. Experience supporting B2B marketing campaigns, preferably in media, advertising, digital marketing, or agency environments. Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and content adaptation skills. Experience creating social media content and managing social posting schedules. Experience building or supporting website pages, landing pages, lead magnets, and digital campaign assets. Ability to turn long-form content into multiple short-form assets for different channels and audiences. Self-starter attitude with excellent time management and project prioritization skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Comfortable working with creative, sales, and cross-functional teams. Customer-centric with a solid understanding of analytics and campaign performance. Ability to work with AI platforms and marketing technology tools. Compensation: Employment offers presented to the selected candidate are based on a combination of qualifications, experience, responsibilities of the role and the candidate's location. Base Salary: $55,000 - $65,000 We thank in advance all applicants for their interest, however only those candidates under consideration will be contacted. Only candidates legally eligible to work in Canada will be considered. No phone calls or agencies please. Postmedia Network Inc. is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities in all areas of the hiring process. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please make your needs known in advance. Accommodation requests will be provided on an individual basis. Postmedia Network Inc. is committed to employment equity and an inclusive barrier-free selection process and work environment. Postmedia Network Inc. encourages applications from women, indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities and members of visible minorities. #Li-remote Originally posted on Himalayas

Cast from the vision of one thousand points of light shared by its founder, President George H.W. Bush, in his 1989 inaugural address, Points of Light was founded in 1990 as an independent, nonpartisan, nonprofit organization to encourage and empower the spirit of service. The organization extends President Bush’s vision that “any definition of a successful life must include serving others.” Today, Points of Light continues to transcend politics and borders to inspire millions of individuals worldwide to take action. Join Us: Be part of a movement that changes lives and communities. Please read the position description below. For more information, visit pointsoflight.org. Any U.S. location in the Eastern or Central time zone in a market with a major airport. Washington, DC preferred. Position Summary : The Manager, Digital Marketing is responsible for Points of Light ’s integrated digital marketing and demand generation engine. This role is the organization’s central hub for digital campaign execution and performance improvement. The role exists to turn organizational priorities into measurable digital outcomes by designing and running repeatable campaign processes across email and marketing automation, search, and website conversion paths, and assists as needed with paid media. This position is accountable for building the structure behind performance—audience targeting, channel strategy, testing plans, landing page experience, and reporting—so that campaigns improve over time and stakeholders can make decisions based on clear results. Position Functions and Responsibilities Include: Integrated campaigns and digital communications Integrate organizational priorities and marketing campaigns into digital channel plans with clear goals, audiences, messages, channel mix, timelines, and measurement. Own the technical end-to-end path from “someone sees it” to “someone takes action,” ensuring that messaging, creative inputs, landing page experience, and follow-up communications are optimized This includes ownership of building emails in Salesforce and regular editing and page creation in WordPress. Build repeatable approaches for lead generation and thought leadership events, such as webinars, downloadable resources, and events—so execution is consistent and continuous improvement is achieved. Ensure campaign work reflects audience behavior and insights, not assumptions, and that performance influences improvements. Demand generation, paid media, and optimization Collaborate with external agencies on paid media strategy and day-to-day management as needed across platforms (LinkedIn, Meta, Google), including targeting, budgeting, pacing, and iterative improvement. Establish and maintain a structured testing approach (audiences, creative, landing pages, channel mix), documenting what worked, what didn’t, and what changes next. Ensure audiences have the best user experience and get the information they need regardless of where they are in the funnel. Make budget recommendations and reallocate based on performance and organizational priorities. Measurement, reporting, and cross-functional alignment Define campaign success metrics up front and maintain a consistent reporting cadence that supports decision-making. Deliver monthly performance updates for email, website, and paid media. Coordinate with operations and database stakeholders as needed to support lead capture, follow-up readiness, and reporting integrity. Core Knowledge, Skills & Abilities: Understanding of digital customer journeys and the technology that supports and enhances those journeys and customer experiences. Strong performance and optimization mindset: comfortable making decisions using data, testing, and iteration. Deep experience translating complex initiatives into clear messaging and high-performing digital journeys. Strong cross-functional collaboration and project management: moves work forward through clarity, alignment, and momentum. Clear communicator who can brief stakeholders, explain results in plain language, and drive next-step decisions. Thank you Join the WeVote Movement Calling all journalists! WeVote , a nonpartisan nonprofit technology startup building the next generation of voting tech, has an open volunteering position for a Writer/Content Developer (2-3+ hours per week) who wants to use their existing skills and learn new skills, while helping strengthen American Democracy. The writer will be tasked with writing engaging and informative content that shares news, information, goals, and wins for our all-volunteer voter activation nonprofit. You will assist with content planning and may also be asked to help with research, interviewing, and writing including writing stories, volunteer profiles, event info, and related news, all designed to build awareness and do a bit of cheerleading. About Us WeVote is a nonpartisan get-out-the-vote nonprofit startup, and a celebrated Fast Forward nonprofit technology grantee. WeVote is a movement of over 120 passionate volunteers (starting with the founders) who are building open-source mobile technologies that touch and mobilize millions of voters on Election Day. We observe that many voters are busy, distracted, and impatient. We have a goal of providing a complete voting experience in 8 minutes, including the download of our app (" WeVote Ballot Guide, @ WeVote Notifications"). More information is at See Twitter @ WeVote . We are a 100% volunteer and remote organization. What You'll Do Write election/voter news related information for our blog and cover WeVote volunteers. observations.description: Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business. Role Overview We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the SEO and AI visibility solutions we build for our clients: more than 20,000 real estate websites that rank independently, each in its own market, with its own authority, its own competitors, and a real business depending on the outcome. This is not the SEO of a single corporate domain or one large marketplace. It is a platform product, where one change to a template, a schema implementation, or the way we render content moves thousands of domains at once. The mandate is an excellent organic discovery platform: technical foundations, page experience, conversion, content, measurement, migrations, and experimentation. AI search is a growing part of that. Our clients are evaluated by Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode, by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, and by every prospective seller who asks an assistant which agent they should call. The best people in this job design for three constituencies at once: the people who visit these sites, the crawlers and AI agents that read them, and the real estate business whose revenue depends on both. This is not a job for someone who runs audits and hands recommendations to other people. You will set the strategy, ship with your own engineering team, and build the defaults, standards, and safeguards that make quality hold across the entire fleet. Most real estate professionals will never hire a technical SEO of their own. Our platform is how they get one. What You'll Do Own the product strategy and roadmap for organic discovery and AI visibility across every site on the platform, including what clients can see, control, and get credit for Own the technical foundations across every page type we generate: crawlability, indexation, rendering, internal linking, structured data, and page performance Productize what repeats. When the same issue or workflow shows up across the fleet, solve it once through better defaults, automation, shared capabilities, or safeguards Make our clients' brands, listings, and expertise legible to AI assistants, and define how we measure citations and visibility across answer engines Run a real experimentation program: prove changes on representative cohorts of sites, establish incremental impact, then scale what works rather than shipping broadly and inferring impact afterward Own migration quality and regression prevention, including the standards, acceptance criteria, and automated checks that hold search quality as the platform ships Partner with the team building the next generation of our website platform so search is designed in from the start, and give every product team a low-friction path to the right implementation Set platform-level goals for organic performance, AI visibility, and client outcomes, and report against them to leadership Who You Are 8+ years combined across SEO and product management, including 3+ years as a product manager shipping alongside engineering teams You have owned search for a platform that hosts many independent customer domains, such as a website builder, a hosting or commerce platform, or a multi-location or franchise network. Running search for one large marketplace or corporate domain is valuable experience, but the fleet problem is a different job and it is the one we have Deep technical foundation across rendering and JavaScript SEO, crawl and index management, information architecture, structured data, page performance, and migrations You treat bots and AI agents as users of a website alongside people, and you design for both without trading one against the other Obsessive about experimentation and measurement, including cohort testing, causal impact analysis, Search Console data at scale, log analysis, and the discipline to tell a result from a coincidence A current point of view on AI search, including how models discover, interpret, and cite a brand, and the judgment to separate what genuinely moves visibility from what is repackaged advice Fluent with AI as a working tool. You use it to investigate messy systems, establish ground truth quickly, prototype solutions, and unblock yourself rather than waiting on another team at every stage of discovery You get requirements implemented by teams you do not own, and you are welcome back afterward. What you write is sharp enough that a team of engineers can move without waiting on you Opinionated about prioritization. This space generates infinite work, and your judgment about what to ignore matters as much as what you ship Preferred Qualifications Experience at a website platform such as Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, WordPress, or Duda Experience with programmatic or template-driven SEO across large page inventories Local and entity-driven search experience, since our clients compete market by market Conversion and page experience work alongside acquisition, since traffic that does not convert does not help a client Background in PropTech, real estate, or another B2B2C category where the platform's job is to make its customers win Experience building client-facing reporting or diagnostic tools for a non-technical audience Join us in shaping the future of real estate The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages. We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition. Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date. More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner. Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform. Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. As Senior Integrated Campaigns Marketing Manager, reporting to the VP of Revenue Marketing, you will own the strategy, execution, and performance of multi-channel campaigns that drive awareness, pipeline, and revenue. This is a highly cross-functional individual contributor role responsible for translating business priorities into coordinated go-to-market execution and measurable impact. We’re looking for a modern demand marketer who combines strong campaign fundamentals with AI-enabled ways of working. You know how to use AI to accelerate research, sharpen audience insight, improve execution, and uncover optimization opportunities — and you have hands-on experience applying AI workflows or agents to real marketing challenges. You apply sound judgment, protect quality, keep the customer experience at the center, and are motivated to keep learning as the tools evolve. targets Define campaign themes, account- and persona-based audience segmentation, offers, and full-funnel activation plans Build integrated campaign briefs outlining messaging, channel mix, KPIs, AI-assisted workflows, prompts, and campaign learnings that improve repeatability and raise the team’s overall speed and quality Partner cross-functionally to identify where AI can improve campaign execution, insight generation, and go-to-market effectiveness without compromising customer experience or brand standards Knowledge and Skills: 5+ years of experience leading integrated B2B marketing campaigns (SaaS preferred) with a proven track record of driving pipeline and revenue impact A well-rounded 360° marketer who can translate business priorities into full-funnel campaign strategy and execute across channels Comfortable operating with urgency in a fast-paced environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on activation and continuous in-market optimization Data-driven and accountable for performance, with experience owning KPIs such as engaged accounts, MQLs, conversion rates, pipeline influence, and revenue contribution Demonstrated experience applying AI in day-to-day marketing work, or a strong track record of proactively experimenting with new AI tools and translating that curiosity into measurable workflow improvements Systems-oriented builder who creates scalable campaign frameworks and leverages AI and automation to increase speed, repeatability, and efficiency Strong judgment in applying AI responsibly, including knowing when to rely on automation, when to validate outputs, and when human review is essential Strong cross-functional collaborator experienced partnering across Sales, Product Marketing, Content, Brand, Events, and Operations Experience supporting account-based marketing motions (1:many/1:few) and partnering with Sales on account prioritization and follow-up Proficient in HubSpot, Salesforce, WordPress, and relevant ABM tools (6sense, Demandbase, UserGems) Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field (or equivalent experience) What Will Make You Stand Out: Experience scaling campaigns in a growth-stage B2B SaaS company Strong partnership with content and creative teams to bring campaigns to life Practical examples of using AI to improve campaign speed, content quality, experimentation, personalization, or performance insights Experience building repeatable AI workflows or agents that improved marketing efficiency or campaign outcomes A self-directed habit of testing new tools and turning one-off AI use into repeatable team practices Experience managing paid media strategy and agency relationships Familiarity with marketing automation and lifecycle strategy Experience building repeatable ABM playbooks, including target account segmentation, buying group considerations, and account-level measurement Experience marketing to commercial service contractors or within field service technology A few things you want to know: What does ServiceTrade do? Founded in 2012, ServiceTrade is the software platform for commercial mechanical and fire contractors. More than 1,300 contractors use ServiceTrade to increase profit and deliver more work during a persistent skilled labor shortage by improving service and project operations, helping technicians be more productive and do their best work, selling more service and inspection agreements, and growing customer loyalty. Over 10% of the commercial or industrial buildings in the United States are serviced by contractors using ServiceTrade to manage 13 million equipment assets and invoice more than $7.5 billion of service-related commerce. Ok, so why should I care about that? Our customers are smart, hard-working people who we enjoy serving. We help them grow their business to earn more revenue, employ more blue-collar workers, and become more valuable to their customers. It’s why we get excited about serving a market that you might never have thought about before. What kind of working environment do you have? We’ve transitioned from a start-up to a scale-up -- that means we still have the spirit and energy of a start-up and are adding new people who will help us expand our business faster and run our business smarter. We have big ambitions and every employee understands our goals and what their role is in achieving them. Read about our company culture on our About Us page. What kind of benefits do you offer? This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. ServiceTrade is not registered to hire in all 50 states. You must reside in one of the states listed to be considered. (AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, KY, LA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WA) Please Be Aware of Recruiting Scams To protect yourself against the increasing number of recruiting scams, please make sure that you are communicating with ServiceTrade . We communicate through our corporate website , through corporate emails utilizing our domain name of @, and through servicetrade.greenhouse.io. Be vigilant when checking domains because imitators often make very small changes to trick the eye. Additionally, please know that ServiceTrade does not use text messaging or public messaging platforms, such as Telegram or Whatsapp, to make initial contact with candidates and ServiceTrade will never ask an employment candidate for financial information or for payment of any kind. observations.description: Higher Logic exists to connect people, knowledge, and ideas to improve lives and organizations. Through our community solutions, we empower growth-stage businesses and associations to build a more engaged and meaningful relationship with their customers and members. Higher Logic serves more than 3,000 customers, representing over 350,000 online communities with greater than 200 million users in more than 42 countries worldwide. Our team is a thriving community of authentic people with diverse experiences and perspectives. We are honest and genuine and believe that sharing ideas and feedback openly helps us to be successful. We believe that diversity and empathy bring us #AllTogether to make us stronger. We learn from failure and successes because both help us to grow and learn. We strive to understand the why behind our actions and bring our best selves to work every day. Higher Logic is looking for a Content Marketing Manager to help us create useful, engaging content for two core audiences: associations and B2B companies. Reporting to the Senior Content Marketing Manager, this person will contribute ideas to Higher Logic ’s broader content strategy and independently manage content projects from concept through publication and promotion. The role is highly hands-on and includes writing and editing blog posts, ebooks, guides, webinar content, website copy, and organic social media content. This person will also help manage Higher Logic ’s social media presence. Social media experience is highly preferred, but this is not solely a social media position. The right candidate will be an adaptable writer and thoughtful marketer who enjoys working across formats, helping brands tell compelling stories, and turning business priorities into clear, valuable content. Higher Logic is a high-trust, collaborative organization. Some projects will begin with an established brief or campaign direction, while others will give this person the opportunity to recommend an approach and shape the work themselves. We are looking for someone who can become comfortable with our audiences, products, and voice and then confidently move projects forward without extensive day-to-day direction. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Create blog posts, ebooks, guides, webinar content, website copy, organic social content, and occasional email or campaign copy. Contribute ideas to the broader editorial calendar by identifying audience needs, industry developments, and timely content opportunities. Manage assigned content projects from initial concept through research, drafting, stakeholder review, revision, publication, and promotion. Help manage Higher Logic ’s organic social media channels, including content planning, writing, scheduling, publishing, engagement, and performance reporting. Create social media carousels, short-form videos, and other visual content using established design templates. Interview and collaborate with subject matter experts to translate complex ideas, product information, research, and industry trends into clear and useful content. Adapt messaging for different audiences, formats, and channels while maintaining a consistent Higher Logic brand voice. Apply SEO and digital discoverability best practices to content planning and production. Manage freelance writers and other external content partners when projects are outsourced, including developing briefs, providing feedback, and maintaining deadlines and quality standards. Review content and social performance to identify lessons and opportunities for improvement. Collaborate closely with demand generation, product marketing, customer marketing, brand, design, subject matter experts, and other partners across Higher Logic . Conduct all business in accordance with Higher Logic values, policies, and procedures. Knowledge and Abilities Required At least three years of relevant experience in content marketing, editorial, communications, or a related field. Experience writing and editing both long-form and short-form content for multiple formats. Working knowledge of SEO principles and their application to content creation. Comfort using AI-powered tools and documented workflows to accelerate content development, streamline repeatable tasks, and improve team efficiency, while maintaining strong editorial judgment and quality control. Strong editorial judgment and the ability to turn complex or loosely defined topics into accessible, audience-focused content. Strong project-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. The initiative and judgment to move work forward independently while knowing when to seek input or collaboration. Comfort using performance data to evaluate content and inform future work. Experience collaborating with designers, marketers, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders. A bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience managing organic social media channels for a brand or organization. Experience managing freelance writers, agencies, or content vendors. Familiarity with B2B SaaS, associations, membership organizations, online communities, or marketing technology. Familiarity with tools such as WordPress, Semrush, GA4, HubSpot, Salesforce, Hootsuite, Canva, ChatGPT, or Riverside. What You Can Expect A remote working environment, with access to Higher Logic ’s Arlington-area headquarters for employees located near Washington, D.C. A collaborative marketing team that values thoughtful ideas, open feedback, and strong cross-functional partnerships. Meaningful ownership of projects and the autonomy to determine how your work takes shape. The opportunity to work across content formats, audience segments, and channels rather than being limited to one area of marketing. A team that is actively experimenting with AI and improving the way content work gets done. You’ll earn: Competitive compensation. Comprehensive health benefits package. 401(k) plan with employer match. Healthcare and dependent-care flexible spending account. Company short-term and long-term disability insurance. Company culture that recognizes its employees. Room for growth and development and management that cares about your professional growth and will help you achieve your goals. Significant advancement opportunities for outstanding performers. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: About Pantheon Pantheon WebOps Platform powers the open web, running more than 300,000 sites in the cloud for customers including Google, Princeton, Salesloft, and Doctors Without Borders. Every day, thousands of developers and marketers create, iterate, and scale WordPress and Drupal sites to reach billions of people globally. Pantheon ’s multitenant, container-based platform enables organizations to manage all of their websites from a single dashboard. Organizations, including Clorox and the United Nations, drive results through accelerated development and real-time publishing using Pantheon ’s collaborative workflows. As a critical member of our sales team, you’ll develop and execute a strategic sales plan to close deals, build strong client relationships, and contribute to Pantheon ’s success . What you Need to Succeed Drive net new business by generating a pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner collaboration, and strategic territory management. Lead discovery calls and navigate technical sales conversations with CTOs, CIOs, CMOs, Directors, VPs, and other executive-level stakeholders, including technical and marketing buyers. Deliver compelling value propositions, leveraging a methodology like Force Management’s Command of Message. Effectively qualify opportunities using frameworks like MEDDIC. Own and exceed your annual quota by closing deals while identifying new opportunities. Manage the entire sales process from lead generation to close, maintaining a focus on speed-to-value and customer success. Maintain a disciplined approach to pipeline management and forecasting to ensure consistent revenue achievement. Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales Development, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, and Customer Success to ensure a seamless and effective buyer’s journey What you Bring to the Table 7-10 years of experience in technical or MarTech SaaS sales, with a strong focus on outbound efforts and net new business acquisition. Comfortable selling to a developer persona Experience with established sales methodologies like Force Management’s Command of the Message or Winning by Design's SPICED. Familiarity with qualification frameworks like MEDDIC or SPICED Proven ability to generate your pipeline through outbound calling, prospecting, and identifying top targets. Demonstrated success in closing deals consistently and achieving or exceeding quota. A resourceful, scrappy mindset, able to build pipeline and opportunities without heavy lead support or brand recognition. Strong ability to ramp quickly and adapt to a technical sale, often starting with technical stakeholders. Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Polished, professional demeanor with the ability to engage effectively at all organizational levels. Familiarity with open-source technology is a significant advantage Willingness to travel approximately 20-30% of the time What We Offer We have all the usual perks and benefits but what we can really offer you is a fantastic work environment powered by an amazing team. Industry competitive compensation and equity plan Flexible time off, sick days, and 13 paid holidays Comprehensive medical insurance including Health, Dental and Vision Paid parental leave (plus fertility, adoption and other family planning benefits) In-office workspace (San Francisco & Chicago) Monthly allowance for wellness, reading and access to LinkedIn Learning for continued development Events and activities both team-based and company wide that inspire, educate and cultivate The on-target earnings (OTE) for this position are: US: $246,200–$300,000 OTE , with a 50/50 base-to-variable compensation split Final compensation will be determined based on factors including role scope, relevant experience, and geographic location. observations.description: The role: Being a web designer at B12 is being a main contributor to the success of the company! At B12 , our web designers use our design suite to put together initial websites for our customers after drafts have already been made by our AI. You'll work closely with our customer success team and our other design experts to focus on what you love most--design! If you enjoy freelancing, designing websites, and working in an open and creative environment, then the web designer role with B12 is the right fit for you! As a web designer you will: Read and interpret customer briefs. Our current customers are small and medium-sized businesses ranging from cafés to real estate investment firms. Given a new customer's content and preferences, as well as a website that has been automatically generated for the customer, use our Design Suite (a largely WYSIWYG website editor with support for custom HTML5/CSS overrides) to put an initial website together for the customer in ~4 hours. Complete enhancement requests for existing customer websites, ranging from small changes to more complex customizations or design improvements. As a fast-growing platform, there will be adjacent opportunities as reviewers and mentors for the right candidates who wish to grow with us. In our experience with past customers, designers spend single-digit numbers hours on each project, with iterative feedback from our team. You might intersperse multiple customers’ project delivery while waiting on design feedback from the customer and our design lead. In addition to doing customer delivery work, you will be helping us co-design our Design Suite, as well as a workflow management tool called Orchestra. We have open sourced Orchestra, and are building it to empower creative and analytical experts in their work. You'll be a good fit if: You are remote or a local NYC web designer. You have excellent written English skills. You have 3-5 years of web design experience and are excited to do customer-focused website delivery. You have 1-2 years of HTML/CSS experience. You are available minimum 10 hours a week, maximum 20 hours a week. You are comfortable turning unstructured customer content and requests into into pixel-perfect web designs that work on all devices. You are excited to receive feedback from a customer success manager or an art director, and are equally excited to push back on design decisions you disagree with. You have desktop and mobile web design experience. You are happy to work on a customer deliverable for a few hours at a time, and then move on to a different customer's deliverable. You are excited to learn our Design Suite. You care about and want to contribute to our mission of helping people do meaningful work. Don't fear: We're flexible on the number of years of previous experience for this role. We highly favor talent and interest. Some candidates may see this list and feel discouraged because they don’t match all the items. Please apply anyway: there’s a good chance you’re more wonderful than you think you are. B12 is a safe place for human beings. We particularly encourage you to apply if you identify as a woman, are a person of color or other underrepresented minority, or are a member of the LGBTQIA community. Benefits: Get paid for your expertise, we value the skills you bring as a designer. Grow within our community - join other designers in our network (we actively use Slack) and get feedback to help you grow. Shape the future of work - we highly value your input and working together we hope to design tools to change the way we work. About B12 The workplace is undergoing rapid transformation, and B12 is on a mission to help people accomplish more at work. Orchestra, the engine behind B12 ’s Human-assisted A.I. model, is currently used to help teams of expert designers build and manage beautiful and professional websites. Leveraging A.I. to streamline complex workflows, B12 delivers superior outcomes for both creative experts and customers who receive a high-touch experience and a self-optimizing website in days, not weeks. Using intelligent software to automate repetitive tasks, B12 allows people to leverage their expertise where it matters most, paving the way to greater craftsmanship, superhuman productivity, and a brighter future of work. Backed by one of the best human-machine teams in the world, B12 recently closed its $12.4M Series A round led by General Catalyst Partners, Breyer Capital, Founder Collective, SV Angel, and more. observations.description: Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick. About us Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable. Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices . With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels , including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search. We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic . We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst , and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on. Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, andthe results speak for themselves. From day one, Insider One ’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables , our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM. Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading. What we’re looking for We’re looking for a systems-minded, digitally fluent Senior Designer to build the visual foundations that make Insider One unmistakable and scalable. Working with the Creative Director, Website Development Team, and other designers, you’ll own brand systems and web design from concept to production-ready execution, creating the components, templates, and page experiences that help global marketing move faster without sacrificing quality. This hands-on senior individual-contributor role is for someone who thinks beyond one-off assets. You’ll translate brand and business goals into responsive websites, landing pages, campaign systems, and reusable frameworks; partner with developers through handoff and QA; and use Claude and MCP-enabled tools to accelerate exploration, prototyping, documentation, and production. You’ll thrive in ambiguity and own the work until it is live. What You Will Do Partner with the Creative Director to evolve Insider One ’s visual identity and turn brand strategy into distinctive, high-performing digital experiences. Build and document scalable brand systems in Figma, including components, variables, grids, templates, iconography, illustration, typography, and image treatments. Own website pages, landing pages, launch experiences, and microsites from information structure and wireframes to responsive, developer-ready design. Work closely with the Website Development Team on interactions, feasibility, accessibility, performance, handoff, and detailed design QA before launch. Design for WordPress confidently, understanding templates, reusable modules, CMS constraints, and responsive behavior; Elementor is a strong advantage. Turn ambiguous briefs and complex B2B technology into clear design directions, prototypes, and visual stories, presenting and defending the rationale. Create reusable templates and self-service systems that help designers and global marketing teams produce consistent, on-brand work at speed. Use Claude, Adobe AI tools, and Model Context Protocol-enabled workflows to research, ideate, prototype, automate repetitive work, and improve developer handoff. Review live implementation and other designers’ work, giving precise feedback that protects the brand, raises craft, and develops the wider team. Manage multiple projects with strong file hygiene, version control, documentation, and prioritization, using performance feedback to improve future work. What You Will Need 6+ years of experience in brand, visual, digital, or web design within fast-growth B2B SaaS, technology, a design studio, or an agency. A standout portfolio showing sophisticated brand systems, responsive web design, digital campaigns, and clear technology storytelling. Expert Figma skills, including Auto Layout, components, variants, variables, libraries, prototyping, responsive systems, and developer handoff. High professional proficiency across Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Acrobat, After Effects, and Premiere Pro. Exceptional visual craft across typography, layout, composition, grids, hierarchy, color, image selection, and digital art direction. Strong systems thinking, with proven experience turning visual identity into reusable components, templates, guidelines, and frameworks. Strong knowledge of web and UX principles, including responsive behavior, accessibility, conversion, performance, interaction, and technical constraints. Working knowledge of WordPress from a designer’s perspective, including CMS constraints and implementation validation; Elementor is a plus. Experience collaborating with developers, preparing clear specifications, resolving implementation questions, and completing meticulous QA. Practical, daily use of AI tools such as Claude and Adobe Firefly for research, concepting, iteration, production, and documentation. Hands-on familiarity with Model Context Protocol workflows connecting Figma to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar environments. Comfort with speed and ambiguity, defining problems, proposing direction, managing feedback, and owning work through delivery. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with confidence explaining decisions and working directly with senior stakeholders. A collaborative, low-ego approach, with the ability to strengthen other designers’ work and contribute across global teams. Was this role made for you? Let’s talk! We’re curious beings and can’t wait to get to know you. We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not only welcome but also embrace everyone, regardless of sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status. What We Offer Enjoy a monthly meal allowance designed to enhance your daily routine. Access comprehensive private health insurance. Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and Neoskola, and CloudGuru. Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills. Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets, where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together. Become a Shareowner through our eligibility-based “ESOP” and own a piece of what you build. Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses. Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose-driven social impact projects. From global retreats to team-building activities, expect year-round events that turn into lifelong memories. Get inspired by the greatest minds in the tech industry through events like our Tech & Dev Talks. We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there. To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile. If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you. We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status. Please follow Insider One on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and Medium! Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business. Role Overview We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the SEO and AI visibility solutions we build for our clients: more than 20,000 real estate websites that rank independently, each in its own market, with its own authority, its own competitors, and a real business depending on the outcome. This is not the SEO of a single corporate domain or one large marketplace. It is a platform product, where one change to a template, a schema implementation, or the way we render content moves thousands of domains at once. The mandate is an excellent organic discovery platform: technical foundations, page experience, conversion, content, measurement, migrations, and experimentation. AI search is a growing part of that. Our clients are evaluated by Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode, by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, and by every prospective seller who asks an assistant which agent they should call. The best people in this job design for three constituencies at once: the people who visit these sites, the crawlers and AI agents that read them, and the real estate business whose revenue depends on both. This is not a job for someone who runs audits and hands recommendations to other people. You will set the strategy, ship with your own engineering team, and build the defaults, standards, and safeguards that make quality hold across the entire fleet. Most real estate professionals will never hire a technical SEO of their own. Our platform is how they get one. What You'll Do Own the product strategy and roadmap for organic discovery and AI visibility across every site on the platform, including what clients can see, control, and get credit for Own the technical foundations across every page type we generate: crawlability, indexation, rendering, internal linking, structured data, and page performance Productize what repeats. Executive, Business and Personal Support Manage calendars, scheduling and inboxes for the three-person leadership team Triage messages, draft routine replies, identify decisions required, and turn observations.description: You must have legal authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship or restriction and be located within the continental U.S. Position Summary: The Senior Communications Analyst – Match Operations leads the planning, development, coordination, delivery, and evaluation of communications that support the accurate and timely execution of NRMP Match activities. Operations communications translate Match processes, policies, system changes, deadlines, and data into clear, actionable information and educational resources for applicants, programs, institutions, medical schools, specialty organizations, and other Match stakeholders. The role serves as the communications subject matter resource for day-to-day and strategic Match operations needs and is responsible for the lifecycle of operational messaging, from identifying communication needs and audiences through drafting, review, scheduling, publication, maintenance, and evaluation. The position works closely with Match Operations department leadership and all staff to ensure communications are accurate, appropriately timed, consistent across channels, and clear about the actions participants must take. The Senior Communications Analyst – Match Operations is part of the Communications Department, and the role collaborates closely with the Senior Public Relations Specialist on shared departmental projects, and when requested, while maintaining distinct accountability for Match process, system, deadline, and support communications. Security and Privacy responsibilities are identified in the Acceptable Use Policy (AUP), which applies to all users, roles, and NRMP resources. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Operations Communications Planning and Governance Own and maintain an integrated communications plan and calendar for the Main Residency Match and Specialties Matching Service, including Match milestones, deadlines, system events, policy and system updates, and educational campaigns. Partner with Match Operations leadership and all staff to identify needs, define objectives and audiences, determine appropriate channels and timing, and establish review and approval pathways. Develop communications plans for new or changing Match processes, R3 system functionality, and other operational initiatives. Anticipate risks, dependencies, and constituent questions from Match participants; identify what users need to know, when they need to know it, and what resources will help them take appropriate action. Lead communication planning and response efforts for high-volume and high-visibility Match activities, including Match Week, SOAP, Match Day, and SMS results releases. Develop contingency messaging and coordinate timely messaging related to operational issues, system disruptions, and other time-sensitive matters. Establish and maintain standards, templates, workflows, and process documentation governing day-to-day Match communications with Match participants, including quality control, version management, approvals, scheduling, and publication. Develop goals and practical measures for assessing the reach, clarity, timeliness, and effectiveness of outreach efforts; use available feedback and performance data to recommend and implement improvements. Work with Match operations team to review and prepare day-to-day email messaging across all Matches: Prepare new or update existing email content for Main Residency Match and Fellowship Matches Assist the Match Operations leadership with day-to-day email messaging to users about the Match process. Write, set-up, schedule and serve as a reviewer for operations messaging. Ensure accuracy and consistency of formatting; make recommendations to management for consideration Match Education and Content Management Develop and maintain web content that helps users understand and navigate Match registration, ranking, results, and related processes. Create and update checklists, support guides, FAQs, presentations, webinar materials, scripts, videos, infographics, visual learning aids, and other resources for Match audiences. Lead periodic reviews of Match Operations content to identify outdated, duplicative, inconsistent, or unclear information and coordinate revisions with subject matter experts. Ensure Match Operations website content and documents remain current, accurate, accessible, and aligned across channels; publish approved website updates and verify links and related resources. Collaborate with other departments on organizational content needs and ensure Match Operations information is accurately represented across NRMP communications channels. Social Media and Audience Engagement Develop channel-appropriate content that informs and educates audiences about Match activities, deadlines, requirements, available resources, process, and outcomes. Develop graphics, multimedia, FAQs, and other materials to support online posts related to Match operations. Coordinate with the Senior Public Relations Specialist on the organization’s social media calendar and online presence. Lead content creation related to Match processes, operational milestones, participant actions, and education. Monitor questions and recurring areas of confusion related to Match Operations; recommend clarifying content, targeted outreach, or resource updates. Prepare accurate and timely responses to operational questions received through public channels and facilitate accurate responses to media inquiries related to Match operations by coordinating with appropriate subject matter experts. Monitor and track social media tags, keywords, handles, and issues pertaining to Match operations activities and initiatives. Establish and continually monitor the framework, policies, and key process documentation for social media practices. Lead creation and distribution of the Illuminator newsletters. Create content that highlights NRMP initiatives, and important topics within GME to promote understanding and support of NRMP mission, purpose, and strategic priorities for Match related content. Content Design and Production Collaborate with and manage vendors and internal partner relationships, as assigned, on content management (WordPress) system updates, multimedia production, analytics tracking, project work, and communications technology needs. Create clear, accessible visual content and infographics that explain Match processes, timelines, requirements, and data. Use established brand standards and templates to produce or coordinate production of digital and print materials. General Communications Projects Jointly develop, maintain, and execute a comprehensive departmental communications plan that aligns with organizational priorities. Create detailed project‑level communications plans to ensure clear messaging, coordinated timing, and effective internal department and external stakeholder engagement across initiatives. Partner with the Senior Public Relations Specialist to design and disseminate customized messages and multimedia materials segmented by audiences to ensure relevant information is communicated to audiences at the right time through NRMP communications channels; including but not limited to, website content, newsletters, emails, blog posts, talking points, presentations, speeches, webinars, factsheets, infographics, reports, data visualizations, videos, brochures, and exhibit materials. Provide operational, policy, process, and Match subject matter expertise to the Senior Public Relations Specialist for press releases and public-facing announcements and review content for accuracy. Maintain and contribute to NRMP’s editorial standards and style guidelines, templates, and coordinated calendars to support consistent, timely communications across the organization. Provide support for Communications Department initiatives and deliverables outside of primary areas of responsibility, as needed to meet organizational priorities. Draft and update process documents for the Communications department Minimum Qualifications, Knowledge, and Skills Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, public relations, journalism, or a related field required. 5 or more years of communications, content strategy, marketing, or related experience required. Demonstrated experience translating complex policies, processes, technical information, system requirements, or data into clear, user-friendly, actionable communications, and educational resources for varied audiences. Experience planning and executing multi-channel communications campaigns with multiple deadlines, reviewers, dependencies, and stakeholder groups. Exceptional writing, editing, proofreading, verbal communication, and interpersonal skills, with strong attention to detail and accuracy. Experience with email marketing or communications platforms, content management systems, social media management tools, and web publishing. WordPress, Constant Contact, and Hootsuite experience preferred. Experience creating presentations, infographics, and digital content using Canva or comparable design software. Ability to exercise sound judgment; manage sensitive, high-impact, and time-critical communications; and distinguish operational questions from reputational issues requiring escalation. Strong project management, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to manage concurrent priorities and meet deadlines in a remote work environment. Ability to build collaborative relationships and coordinate work across departments while maintaining clear ownership, review, and approval responsibilities. Preferred Qualifications Experience with healthcare, association, nonprofit, education, or other regulated or process-intensive environment. Knowledge of the Match and graduate medical education. Experience interpreting data for non-research audiences and using communications analytics or audience feedback to improve content. observations.description: About Us Shorthand exists to empower creative teams to produce and publish beautiful, transformative content radically faster. We've begun our journey by creating an easy-to-use platform for one of the most creatively and technically demanding use cases on the web — immersive feature stories — and we're proud to count many of the world's best known and most discerning publishers, brands, not-for-profits and universities as loyal customers. Shorthand is a growing, investor-backed company with customers on every continent (except Antarctica!), and there's never been a more exciting time to join our band of geeks with art and heart. We're looking for an entrepreneurial Senior Account Executive to join our Sales team, based in North America (Washington DC, NYC, or Boston preferred; other East Coast locations considered) on a fully remote basis. What you'll be doing The mission of Shorthand is to create a beautifully informed world. To do that, we need to build a platform that makes it easy to create immersive reading experiences for the web, because it would otherwise be unaffordable and painfully cumbersome for organisations to produce this type of content. Our Senior Account Executives are a big part of the Shorthand magic. This role is responsible for building pipeline, opening new enterprise relationships, and driving complex consultative sales cycles. You'll engage both business and technical stakeholders — including marketing, content, editorial, digital experience and web platform teams — and operate autonomously across the full sales cycle, from prospecting through to close. This is an ideal role for someone who thrives in early-stage product commercialisation and enjoys creating structure, messaging and momentum in a new market category. You'll join our Sales team and report to the Head of Sales. In this role you'll: Build and manage a disciplined outbound pipeline targeting enterprise organisations. Prospect into marketing, content, communications, digital experience and web platform teams within medium and large enterprises. Develop multi-threaded relationships across both business and technical buying groups. Create and execute strategic account plans for named target accounts. Become a trusted advisor by understanding customer priorities and demonstrating how Shorthand supports their strategic objectives. Build long-term relationships with senior stakeholders while driving new business and expansion opportunities. Develop tailored proposals and presentations that address customer needs and business outcomes. Own commercial negotiations and successfully close complex enterprise opportunities. Forecast pipeline accurately, including expected close date, projected deal size and probability. Work collaboratively with Customer Success, Sales, Channel Partners, Growth, Marketing, Product and Engineering to deliver outstanding customer outcomes and provide valuable market feedback. We are looking for someone who: Has a proven track record of building outbound pipeline and closing enterprise SaaS deals in complex buying environments. Is comfortable prospecting into medium and large enterprises and engaging multiple stakeholder groups across marketing, content, communications, editorial, digital and web platform teams. Can demonstrate success growing strategic accounts through a combination of new business acquisition, expansion and executive relationship building. Has experience selling CMS, digital publishing, martech, DXP or related technology solutions into enterprise organisations. Is commercially driven, highly autonomous, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with limited structure and high ownership. Is technically credible and confident discussing CMS workflows, integrations and implementation considerations with customer web and platform teams. Can independently run discovery, product demonstrations and commercial conversations without relying heavily on presales or solution engineering support. Has strong consultative selling skills and can connect Shorthand 's platform capabilities to strategic customer objectives around content, storytelling, engagement and digital experience. Communicates exceptionally well in both written and verbal formats, and can simplify complex concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences. Learns quickly, prioritises effectively, and maintains high attention to detail while managing multiple enterprise sales cycles simultaneously. Thrives working remotely and collaboratively across distributed teams and time zones. Brings curiosity, resilience and initiative, and enjoys helping shape go-to-market strategy for emerging products and categories. Experience & Qualifications Significant experience successfully selling enterprise marketing solutions to CEOs, CMOs, VPs and Directors of Marketing, Content, Communications, Editorial and related functions. Experience selling into organisations using WordPress, Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, Contentful, Optimizely, Drupal or similar CMS/DXP platforms. Experience navigating technical validation processes with digital, engineering or web platform teams. Ability to independently deliver product demonstrations and manage technical discovery conversations without dedicated presales support. Experience introducing new products to market. Proven track record of closing large, strategic, high-quality deals. Proven success in both direct and partner-led sales. Technical aptitude or background in technology is highly regarded. A consultative sales style and experience selling solutions in a fast-paced environment. Proven ability to sell collaboratively across multiple internal stakeholders and teams. Personality Attributes You are a proactive self-starter who doesn't need to be told what to do and is resourceful in finding solutions. You are collaborative, consultative and not afraid to get your hands dirty. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and possess a high level of curiosity. You are goal-oriented, resilient and motivated by achieving outstanding results. You are a supportive and proactive team player. You love working remotely. You are tech-savvy and excited to become an expert in the Shorthand platform. Why work for us We offer: Fully remote working, flexible hours and a co-working allowance if you'd like one. True autonomy, with the freedom to own and grow your territory. The opportunity to shape our enterprise sales motion as we continue to grow across North America. A category-defining product trusted by leading global brands, publishers, universities and not-for-profits. The opportunity to work in a growing SaaS company that's still small enough for you to make a real impact. A home office allowance, laptop and any peripherals you need to do your best work. An Employee Share Option Plan for all team members. A Health & Wellness Allowance together with access to coaching and counselling services. A 401(k) plan and 100% employer-paid healthcare premiums for US-based team members. Paid parental leave if you're growing your tribe. A proudly carbon-neutral organisation, taking climate action with Trace as part of our broader sustainability strategy. A base salary range of US$110,000–125,000, with additional variable commission. Actual compensation will depend on your skills, experience and local market benchmarks. Shorthand 's interview process We value direct communication and want to be transparent about how we hire. Our process includes: An initial Zoom conversation with the hiring manager. A take-home task using our platform (approximately 2–4 hours). Panel interviews with members of the team, including our CEO. Reference and background checks before a formal offer is made. Our workplace is 100% distributed and all interviews are conducted virtually. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process. observations.description: 🧩 About Alts Alts Digital is a fast-growing, bootstrapped group that builds digital ventures shaping how people engage with information, make decisions, and create value online. We specialize in guiding users to the best services for their needs, driving customer acquisition for leading brands in the iGaming and Fintech sectors. Based in Portugal and operating as a remote-first company, our diverse team of 40+ members from +10 countries serves thousands of customers worldwide. As founders, designers, adventurers, coders, parents, and animal lovers, we move fast, think ambitiously, and are passionate about building products that make an impact. This role goes beyond traditional SEO or content management. You'll be responsible for ensuring our core website features remain accurate, relevant and continuously evolving , while identifying scalable opportunities to grow organic traffic and business impact. This is a hands-on role, requiring writing, editing, managing, and automating content directly. You'll work across SEO, Product and Content, taking ownership of both strategy and execution while using AI and automation to build scalable workflows. The ideal candidate understands that the future of SEO isn't publishing more articles , it's building better products, smarter workflows and scalable content experiences. 👩‍💻 What You'll Be Doing Own the day-to-day management of the website and its core content features. Execute the organic roadmap together with Product. Keep core website sections continuously updated through day-to-day improvements and content maintenance. Identify opportunities to improve existing features or launch new product-led content experiences. Coordinate with the PR & Outreach team to support campaigns, digital PR initiatives and content opportunities. Monitor the local betting markets, following campaigns, promotions, new operators and product launches across major sportsbooks. Transform market insights into new landing pages, website features and organic growth initiatives. Use AI as part of your daily workflow to improve research, content management and operational efficiency. Design scalable workflows that reduce manual work through automation. Track organic performance and continuously optimise based on traffic, engagement and business impact. Requirements 🧠 Your Attitude & Background Strong SEO experience with proven ownership of a large content website. Previous experience in iGaming is highly desirable. Comfortable managing websites rather than simply producing content. Strong understanding of information architecture, internal linking and content strategy. Curious about Product and excited to build features that generate organic traffic. Comfortable using AI daily (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar). Experience thinking in systems and automation rather than manual execution. Strong analytical skills using GA4, Search Console and Ahrefs. Able to identify market opportunities and execute quickly. Native Spanish and Fluent English. ⭐ Nice to Have Experience with sports betting or casino products. Experience launching SEO features, programmatic pages or scalable content products. Experience with CMS platforms (WordPress or headless CMS). Familiarity with APIs, automation tools or AI-assisted publishing. Product mindset with the ability to prioritize based on business impact. 🎁 Benefits You'll Receive Salary range: from €25,000 up to €35,000 gross annual. Remote First: We've built our company around remote work from day one. Work from wherever you do your best thinking. Workation: A mix of work and vacation. Once a year, we find a cool place to work and have fun together. Alts Ville : We have a house in the stunning Madeira Island available for all employees who want to spend some time with friends, colleagues, and family. Time Off: Life is better when you're rested. We offer flexible vacation days so you can recharge on your own terms, plus your birthday off and 2 extra days during the holiday season. Some moments deserve your full attention. Health Insurance : We value the well-being and health of our team. To ensure that everyone feels cared for, we offer Health Insurance. Laptop Support Budget: A yearly budget to support laptop repairs or contribute towards a new device when needed. Learning & Development: €1.000 per year to support your professional development. Co-working allowance: €100 monthly voucherto use in co-working spaces. Originally posted on Himalayas
