observations.description: This is a remote position. AI Web Developer & Digital Production Specialist About Business Financial Group (BFG) Business Financial Group (BFG) is a U.S.-based accounting, tax, payroll, CFO advisory, IRS resolution, and business consulting firm serving business owners across the United States. We help growing businesses build stronger financial systems through coordinated accounting, tax planning, payroll, financial operations, and advisory solutions. BFG is building a rapidly expanding digital ecosystem that includes its primary business website, industry-specific marketing programs, educational academies, partner programs, landing pages, educational resources, webinars, assessments, and other digital lead-generation initiatives. Position Overview We are looking for an AI Web Developer & Digital Production Specialist who can combine practical web-development skills with modern AI-assisted development workflows. This is not a traditional WordPress maintenance position. The ideal candidate understands how AI tools can accelerate website development, page creation, content publishing, testing, troubleshooting, and repetitive web-production work without compromising quality, security, or technical judgment. The candidate should be able to take approved content, designs, wireframes, business requirements, screenshots, or AI-generated prototypes and rapidly convert them into professional, secure, responsive, SEO-friendly, production-ready web experiences. This role will serve as a key technical resource for BFG's website and digital-marketing production, with a focus on building scalable, AI-assisted systems that support growing content and lead-generation needs. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain responsive WordPress websites, landing pages, industry pages, academy pages, campaign pages, and other BFG digital properties. Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, page creation, testing, troubleshooting, and repetitive production work while reviewing AI-generated code before deployment. Convert approved content, designs, wireframes, screenshots, and prototypes into responsive, production-ready webpages. Create reusable templates and components to support blogs, landing pages, resources, webinars, forms, CTAs, assessments, and other recurring content. Manage WordPress themes, plugins, HTML/CSS/JavaScript updates, staging, deployment, security, backups, performance, and technical maintenance. Build efficient publishing workflows that support increasing content volumes and reduce repetitive manual work. Implement approved technical SEO requirements, including metadata, headings, URLs, internal linking, schema, redirects, indexing, image optimization, page speed, and mobile usability. Build and maintain lead-generation functionality, including forms, scheduling, downloads, assessments, webinar registrations, and campaign pages. Support integrations with Zoho applications and other marketing/business systems. Implement analytics and conversion tracking using Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and related platforms. Conduct QA before publication to ensure pages are responsive, functional, secure, properly tracked, SEO compliant, and consistent with approved branding. *AI should improve development speed and productivity, but it does not replace technical judgment, testing, security, quality assurance, or accountability. Websites & Digital Properties The role may support BFG's primary website, industry marketing pages, BFG Academy, Partner Network, tax and campaign pages, webinars, downloadable resources, assessment funnels, blogs, and other digital properties developed as BFG expands. Required Qualifications Strong practical WordPress development experience Strong HTML and CSS skills Working knowledge of JavaScript Experience building responsive websites and landing pages Understanding of hosting, staging, deployment, backups, and security Understanding of technical SEO implementation Experience using AI-assisted development/coding tools Ability to review, debug, and correct AI-generated code Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills Strong attention to detail Ability to manage multiple development tasks and communicate progress clearly Preferred Qualifications Experience with WP Engine, Zoho One/CRM integrations, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, conversion tracking, schema markup, APIs, Git/GitHub, workflow automation, AI coding agents, or high-volume content websites is preferred but not mandatory. Experience developing websites for financial services, education, or other professional-services businesses is also beneficial. What We're Looking For Someone who combines web-development judgment with an AI-first production mindset. The ideal candidate: Thinks in terms of reusable systems rather than repeatedly rebuilding similar pages. Looks for opportunities to automate repetitive development and publishing work. Uses AI to work faster without blindly relying on AI-generated code. Understands that BFG's websites are lead-generation and business-development platforms, not simply informational websites. Works quickly while maintaining quality, security, SEO, tracking, and responsiveness. Reads and follows requirements carefully. Asks concise questions when requirements are unclear. Communicates progress and delays proactively. Takes ownership of technical problems and works collaboratively with marketing, content, and business teams. BFG values speed with accountability. Fast development without communication, testing, or quality control is not acceptable. Key Performance Indicators Performance will be evaluated primarily on: Development speed and on-time delivery Quality, reliability, and responsiveness of completed webpages Technical SEO and website-performance implementation Accuracy of analytics and conversion tracking Effective use of AI-assisted development tools Development of reusable templates, components, and workflows Reduction of repetitive manual development work Troubleshooting and problem-solving Attention to detail and reduction of avoidable errors Communication, documentation, and project-status updates Ability to support increasing digital-production volume Expected Evolution of the Role Initially, the role will focus on BFG's websites, landing pages, industry and academy pages, campaign development, reusable templates, and AI-assisted production workflows. As BFG's digital operation grows, the role will increasingly support publishing automation, reusable components, technical SEO, website performance, conversion optimization, integrations, analytics, and higher content-production volumes. The person in this role will be expected to help design systems that make this scale possible rather than manually processing every publishing task. Compensation ₹8,00,000 – ₹12,00,000 annual CTC, based on experience, demonstrated technical capability, AI proficiency, development speed, and overall performance during the selection process. observations.description: Position: Marketing Operations Specialist, Full time Location: U.S. based Remote or Austin, TX Compensation: Competitive, based on experience ($60,000–$75,000). Includes health, vision, dental insurance and 401(k) You are the kind of person who ships. You can produce clean, brand-aligned copy in the morning, design a carousel before lunch, fix a HubSpot workflow before a meeting, and get caught up with the latest marketing and political breaking news before the day ends - all while keeping Asana clean and up to date. You keep deadlines visible, quality high and projects moving, and you take pride in being the teammate every channel and department depends on. You are a marketing generalist who writes, designs and builds systems with equal confidence. You want your work to show up in search engines, AI-generated answers, social feeds and client campaigns, and you are ready to build your career alongside a team that is scaling fast. Sound familiar? This could be the role you have been searching for. As our Marketing Operations Specialist, you will run the production engine behind RumbleUp marketing. You will own the content, graphics, video and website updates that keep our brand visible, along with the CRM systems that pass qualified leads from marketing to sales. You will also play a crucial role in optimizing the processes that drive efficiency across the entire customer journey funnel. This position is essential to our success in keeping pace with accelerating market demand and new opportunities. You will report directly to the Director of Marketing, who leads brand voice, content strategy, SEO, AEO, GEO, CRM and analytics, and you will collaborate with the sales team and outside freelancers to keep every channel on schedule and on standard. This Role Includes 📍 Monday – Friday work week 🌎 Remote work or in office from Austin, TX Content Creation Write, edit and publish articles, social media posts, newsletters and client text campaigns in the RumbleUp brand voice Uphold consistent editorial standards and factual accuracy across every asset Design & Video Create standalone graphics, article graphics, one-pagers, infographics, carousels and display ads Produce and edit short-form video in Canva and Klap for social, web and campaign use Website & Search Visibility Update and maintain website content through our CMS Optimize pages and content for SEO, AEO and GEO so RumbleUp surfaces in search engines and AI-generated answers Research & Insights Conduct market and strategy research on industry trends, competitors and buyer behavior Turn findings into recommendations that sharpen content plans and campaigns CRM & Lead Operations Build and manage HubSpot workflows, sequences and properties that move qualified leads from marketing to sales Maintain accurate, current contact data so sales always works from clean information Coordination & Process Coordinate freelancers on scope, deadlines and quality Evaluate, implement and document new marketing tools and processes Organize and track work in Asana to keep projects on time and visible Own ad hoc projects, from team happy hours to our annual client gift box send Key Competencies ✨Taste: you can't teach taste easily - it’s earned from reps and from consuming over time, not by prompting 👥Marketing fundamentals: understanding people, psychology, copywriting, the art of persuasion. AI can now write you a headline in 2 seconds, but if you don't understand why 1 headline works and another doesn't, you're not there. ✍️ Writing & Editing: publish-ready marketing copy with consistent editorial standards and factual accuracy 🎨 Design & Video: confident in Canva and experience with AI video tools such as Klap; professional video editing experience on proper software is a plus 🔍 Search Visibility: working command of SEO with the drive to master AEO and GEO ⚙️ Marketing Systems: familiarity with LLMs, HubSpot, WordPress and Asana 🗳️ Political Fluency: understanding of how customer needs shift across levels of office and between election cycles 🧰 Organization: sharp attention to detail and the urgency to prioritize effectively 💡 Initiative: entrepreneurial spirit, proactive mindset and independent problem solving 📣 Communication: clear written and verbal skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and across companies Accountability Metrics Production & Publishing Minimum content requirements = 2 short form videos, 1 article, 1 newsletter, 1 client text, and 4 social media posts across all platforms per month Minimum website requirement = 1 substantial content or SEO/AEO/GEO change/improvement per week On-time completion rate across content, design and web tasks: 95%+ Editorial and factual accuracy on published assets: 98%+ CRM & Lead Operations Minimum CRM/automation requirement = 1 substantial CRM-related change/improvement per week (automation, reports, list building, property maintenance, etc). HubSpot contact data accuracy: 98%+ Qualified lead handoff from marketing to sales: same business day Process & Coordination Process improvement initiatives implemented: 1-2 per quarter Average first response time to internal requests & correspondence: under 8 hours Average first response time to external freelancer/agency requests & correspondence: under 24 hours Requirements We Look For Hands-on experience creating marketing content and graphics; include a portfolio or 5-10 work samples with your application including writing, video, graphic, and technical examples. 3–5 years of B2B marketing operations or a related field preferred Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, English, Communications or Political Science preferred Experience in the world of politics to understand how customer needs shift across levels of office and between election cycles preferred Familiarity with LLMs, HubSpot, WordPress, Canva and Asana preferred; experience with AI video tools such as Klap is a plus Proactive mindset with a willingness to adapt to new trends, tools and technologies Strong organizational skills and sharp attention to detail Entrepreneurial spirit and a high sense of urgency to prioritize tasks effectively Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across teams Demonstrated ability to work independently and take initiative in problem solving Able to furnish professional and personal references upon request Get to Know Us Better! 🥊 RumbleUp is a leading SaaS platform in the organizational texting space, helping campaigns, nonprofits, and organizations connect directly with their audiences through scalable peer-to-peer and broadcast messaging. Our clients rely on our platform to mobilize supporters, conduct polling and surveys, and drive real-world action. Our team is client-focused, collaborative, and highly communicative. During peak seasons, especially in the political and polling space, our work moves quickly and has real impact. Our team culture is built around the following: Our purpose is simple - to help our clients succeed by winning attention in their messaging channel. We obsess over our clients - putting ourselves in their shoes, understanding their challenges, and treating their success as our own. We believe great things happen when everyone’s pulling in the same direction, so we grab an oar and row together. No egos, just teamwork. We’re always looking for ways to raise the bar, whether that’s through honest feedback, learning something new, or pushing for better. We go fast. We bias toward action and move with urgency — because standing still means falling behind. Momentum beats hesitation every time. And we own it - every outcome, every challenge, every success. If something’s not working, we fix it. If we say we’ll do something, we follow through. Simple as that. Salary: $60,000 -$75,000, based on experience Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: About North Star Network North Star Network (NSN) is a global sports and betting media group that builds and operates leading digital brands connecting sports fans and bettors across 30+ countries. Our mission is to turn passion for sports and gaming into trusted information, data-driven insights, and responsible entertainment. We’re a multicultural, fully remote company uniting over 50 in-house and 200+ external experts from more than 20 nationalities across Europe, Africa, and the Americas. About The Role We are looking for a Content Manager to plan, produce, and optimize high-quality content for our Eastern European markets. In this role, you will be responsible for executing the editorial roadmap , ensuring content aligns with SEO priorities, audience expectations, and business objectives . You will collaborate closely with SEO specialists, Editors, Writers, Product teams, and Business stakeholders to deliver engaging content that drives traffic, engagement, and conversions across our digital platforms. Depending on the team structure, you may also coordinate Content Writers or Junior Content Managers , ensuring quality standards and smooth editorial operations. Key Responsibilities Content Planning & Execution Create, plan and manage content production according to the editorial calendar and SEO priorities . Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis to identify new content opportunities. Create detailed content briefs , including target keywords, structure, and tone of voice. Ensure all published content aligns with brand guidelines, audience expectations, and business goals . Oversee the full lifecycle of content production, from ideation to publication , ensuring deadlines and quality standards are met. When relevant, coordinate Writers or Junior Content Managers , reviewing progress and validating deliverables. Content Optimization & Performance Regularly update and optimize existing content to improve SEO rankings and user experience . Monitor content performance using analytics tools and identify opportunities for improvement. Ensure internal linking, metadata, and formatting follow SEO best practices. Work closely with the SEO team to track performance metrics and adjust content strategies accordingly. Quality Control & Collaboration Collaborate with Writers, Editors, and Designers to ensure consistency and accuracy across all published content. Review drafts to guarantee editorial quality, factual accuracy, and clarity . Support the localization or adaptation of content for different Eastern European markets when needed. Participate in content review sessions and share feedback to continuously improve editorial standards and workflows. What We’re Looking For 2+ years of experience in digital content management, editorial roles, or SEO content strategy. Strong understanding of SEO best practices and content performance metrics . Excellent writing, editing, and organizational skills . Ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously . Experience working with CMS platforms (WordPress or similar) is a plus. Familiarity with sports, betting, or iGaming industries is highly valued. Fluent English proficiency ; knowledge of Eastern European languages is a significantly advantage, especially Bulgarian or Czech. Strong attention to detail and commitment to editorial quality and accuracy . What We Offer The opportunity to work on high-traffic sports platforms reaching millions of fans worldwide . A fully remote role with flexible working hours. A multicultural and collaborative team environment . Career development opportunities within a fast-growing international media company . A culture that values autonomy, innovation, and initiative . A competitive salary , based on experience and profile. Ready to Join Us? If you're passionate about sports, digital content, and SEO , and want to contribute to the growth of leading sports platforms across Eastern Europe, we’d love to hear from you. 👉 Apply now and help shape North Star Network ’s content strategy across Eastern Europe. observations.description: The location for this posting is in the APAC region. We work in English, so excellent written and spoken English is essential. Freelancing at Human Made Join Human Made as a freelancer and you’ll feel like part of the team. You’ll be working on interesting and complex projects, alongside some of the industry's top talent. We’re fully remote, and have been for over 10 years, so you can expect well established ways of working, and a vibrant online culture. Once you are qualified, you'll be added to our freelance talent pool and be invited to projects that suit your availability and expertise as soon as they become available, which might not be immediately. Once you are booked on a project, you will integrate as part of the team, so you are expected to join team meetings and activities (although we have a strong emphasis on asynchronous communication). The Scrum Master Role at Human Made As a Scrum Master you will create self-organising teams that are flexible and fully productive during sprints, with the goal of creating high performing teams. To do this you should be able to plan deliverables and help teams monitor their performance. You should have a thorough understanding of scrum/agile concepts, and can apply them through coaching and mentoring. You understand value, as it applies to the companies we work with and its alignment with our own priorities, and you are consistent in pursuing it. Responsibilities: These are the main areas of focus for a Scrum Master: Applying Scrum To Produce High Quality Work Manage each projects scope and timeline Create and maintain a team culture that facilitates a shared responsibility for successful delivery Guide team on principles and practice of the agile framework being used in the project Work with team to help define and refine project scope, estimates, and resource requirements for projects Prepare and facilitate workshops (either virtual or in-person) to establish project needs and relationships Facilitate meetings to monitor project progress and resolve any issues the team may be experiencing Remove impediments or guide the team to remove impediments Assess the time and financial impact of scope change and communicate to stakeholders as appropriate Identifies when to use experiments for learning and solutioning Accountability To The Business Be commercially aware: Understand the status of the budget of your projects and be able to report on them back to the company Allocation management of project needs in conjunction with your squad composition Building And Safeguarding Relationships Facilitate wider engagement with internal and external stakeholders, and partners engaged in delivery Build a partnership relationship with clients, understanding their business imperatives as context for helping align the team on those goals Understand the workings and needs of the account you are partnered with Communicate regularly; be proactive in facing difficult conversations Manage your interactions with clients and internal team professionally, and personably Using data to allow the team and wider business to make critical decisions Striving For Great Work Develop creative and technical judgement and strive for high quality output Share progress and communicate to internal and external stakeholders Conduct team reviews and retrospectives to promote continuous improvement Endorse and present appropriate metrics to sustain continuous improvement to get the best out of each team. Report progress, team status, and issues across the board. Requirements Scrum Master certification or qualification, or equivalent work experience Experience applying scrum, a wider awareness of agile principles, and a data driven mindset Enterprise agency environment experience Highly developed skills in servant leadership, facilitation, situational awareness, conflict resolution, continual improvement, empowerment, and increasing transparency Experience in using a wide range of project management tools such as, budget/time tracking tools and issue tracking software with the depth of knowledge to recommend the right tools for a project Proficiency in written and oral communication in English, and ability to utilise and parse through technical terminology comfortably An Interest in AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their appropriate use and limitations Broad understanding of web technologies such as HTML/HTML5, CSS, CMS, Javascript, and version control Benefits Whether you are a freelancer, or a permanent member of the team, we want all Humans to have a fantastic experience, and benefit from Human Made ’s people focused approach to work. Gain experience working in an agency, without a long term commitment Work alongside some of the WordPress industry’s top engineers Access to Slack channels which will open up plenty of opportunities to network with other WordPress peers at Human Made The opportunity to explore Human Made with the potential of becoming a full-time employee Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: About Us Eggs Unlimited is one of the world’s largest suppliers of eggs, serving leading retail and food manufacturing companies around the globe. Every day, we find homes for millions of eggs by using our extensive supply-chain and customer networks. By bringing sellers and buyers together through fair market negotiations, we create opportunities to expand their knowledge, reach, and market access. With dedicated service teams and a commitment to transparency and trust, we provide fast and creative solutions for the constantly evolving global egg industry. Work Schedule Monday through Friday during Pacific Time business hours. Occasional additional or weekend hours may be required depending on business needs. Position Summary We are seeking a proactive, highly organized, and detail-oriented Marketing Operations Coordinator to support our internal and external marketing activities. This position will coordinate marketing communications, manage shared inboxes, schedule meetings, track projects and deadlines, support email campaigns, coordinate vendors, maintain marketing files, and assist with website and creative projects. The ideal candidate communicates clearly, follows through without repeated reminders, manages multiple projects independently, and carefully reviews all work before submission. Duties and Responsibilities Monitor and manage the and inboxes. Respond to internal and external marketing requests promptly and professionally. Manage Intranet Central communications, posts, updates, and requests. Monitor incoming messages and inquiries across company social media platforms. Schedule and coordinate internal and external meetings. Maintain the marketing calendar, project tracker, task assignments, and deadline reminders. Follow up with team members and vendors regarding outstanding assignments and deadlines. Manage Salesloft contacts, campaigns, email blasts, follow-ups, and performance tracking. Assist with implementing and maintaining the company’s CRM system. Organize incoming leads, assign ownership, track follow-ups, and maintain accurate records. Coordinate vendors, request quotes, place orders, and follow up on production and delivery. Order business cards, branded materials, and other marketing supplies. Coordinate the distribution of the monthly newsletter. Prepare PowerPoint presentations, Excel reports, trackers, and other marketing materials. Create and edit basic Canva designs, presentations, social media graphics, flyers, and promotional materials. Assist with WordPress website updates, including pages, blogs, images, links, forms, and other content. Support expo, event, advertising, social media, and other marketing projects as needed. Maintain organized marketing folders and document where logos, letterhead, templates, photographs, and other assets are stored. Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot to support research, communication, content development, and productivity. Write clear and detailed prompts that provide AI tools with the necessary context and instructions. Review, fact-check, edit, and improve all AI-generated work before using or submitting it. Review all work for accuracy, grammar, brand consistency, and overall quality. Handle company contacts, lead lists, vendor information, and internal communications confidentially. Perform other marketing-related duties as assigned. Required Qualifications At least two years of experience in marketing operations, marketing coordination, project coordination, administration, or a related role. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Strong organizational, time-management, and follow-up skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines independently. High attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate work. Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel. Ability to use Excel for trackers, contact lists, reporting, data organization, and basic formulas. Basic Canva design skills, including creating and editing presentations, social media graphics, flyers, and other marketing materials. Experience using large language model tools such as ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot. Ability to write effective AI prompts, provide sufficient context, review AI-generated work, verify accuracy, and revise the final output. Understanding that AI-generated content must never be copied and submitted without human review. Experience creating professional presentations, reports, trackers, and internal communications. Ability to work effectively during Pacific Time business hours. Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote working environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Salesloft, ZoomInfo, HubSpot, Salesforce, or another CRM or lead-management platform. Experience managing email campaigns and contact lists. Familiarity with WordPress or another content management system. Familiarity with social media platforms, analytics, and performance reporting. Basic knowledge of digital marketing, lead generation, and marketing KPIs. Experience coordinating vendors, orders, events, or expo projects. Basic photo or video editing experience is a plus. Performance Expectations The successful candidate will be expected to: Respond to requests promptly and professionally. Complete assignments accurately and on time. Maintain organized and updated project trackers. Follow up consistently without repeated reminders. Communicate when a task has been accepted, completed, or delayed. Keep marketing files, contact records, and campaign information organized. Take ownership of assignments and proactively identify potential issues. Carefully review all AI-generated work before submission. Protect confidential company, customer, lead, and vendor information. Application Requirements Please submit: An updated resume. A link to your portfolio. Examples of relevant presentations, Excel trackers, Canva designs, email campaigns, reports, digital content, or other marketing materials. A brief explanation of your experience managing projects, deadlines, shared inboxes, vendors, email campaigns, CRM platforms, and AI tools. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: We are seeking a versatile, proactive Digital Marketing Executive to join a premier UK-based digital marketing agency that specializes in scaling private healthcare, medical, aesthetic, and wellness practices. The client helps clinics, surgeons, and healthcare professionals establish a powerful digital presence that drives patient inquiries, builds authority, and elevates brand reputation across search and social platforms. In this broad, all-around marketing role, you will support multiple client accounts by building and publishing blog articles, managing social media channels, handling light Canva graphics design, and keeping WordPress sites updated. While deep technical development isn't required, you should be a strong communicator with a sharp eye for content layout, on-page SEO, and modern AI productivity workflows. Part-time: 20 hours per week (with opportunity to grow into full-time) Remote: Fully remote (UK working hours) Engagement Type: Independent Contractor (client based in the UK) Monthly Rate: $600-720 (based on a 20-hour workweek; flexible depending on experience) Key Responsibilities: WordPress Content Publishing & Site Maintenance: Format, build, and publish blog articles, landing pages, and content updates using WordPress page builders (such as Elementor). Perform basic site maintenance, light troubleshooting, and ensure all site content displays flawlessly across mobile and desktop. observations.description: TENGOINTERNET Fractional Marketing Manager Part-time contract (1099) • ~10–15 hours/week • Remote (Central Texas preferred) • $3,000–$5,000/month retainer About TengoInternet TengoInternet is an employee-owned company that has spent more than two decades designing, building, and managing outdoor WiFi networks for campgrounds, RV resorts, glamping destinations, and marinas. Our customers count on us to keep their guests connected and their operations running — and they stay with us because of trust, relationships, and results. Get Connected. Why this role exists Our longtime marketing leader recently moved on, and rather than replace the role one-for-one, we redesigned the function. Strategy is set by our leadership team; automation and specialists handle the heavy systems work. What we need now is a reliable, hands-on marketing generalist to own the marketing execution across our prospect and customer lifecycle — nurturing leads, strengthening customer relationships, supporting expansion and referrals, and ensuring our industry presence translates into measurable business outcomes. This person will also keep our brand present and our busy trade show calendar running smoothly. One thing to know: Tengo wins through relationships and credibility, not marketing volume. Most of our best customers come from referrals and industry events. Your job is to amplify that — keep us top-of-mind with customers and prospects, make every event count, and make sure no lead falls through the cracks. What you’ll own 1. Prospect & Customer Nurturing Own the ongoing marketing cadence for active prospects, dormant opportunities, customers, and strategic accounts. Ensure trade-show leads, closed/lost opportunities, early-stage construction projects, and other “not now” prospects enter appropriate nurture programs rather than disappearing from view. Partner with Sales and Customer Success to identify and execute customer expansion campaigns around portfolio growth, network lifecycle/upgrade opportunities, new services, and other relevant Tengo capabilities. Build recurring customer communications that support retention, expansion, referrals, upgrades, and adoption of additional Tengo services. Identify customer wins that can become testimonials, referrals, case studies, reviews, or other trust-building assets. Work with our HubSpot specialist to translate lifecycle needs into automated workflows and sequences. 2. Content & Thought Leadership: emails and blogs •Write and schedule recurring email campaigns in HubSpot: educational content for existing customers, nurture touches for prospects and dormant leads, and pre/post-event sends. •Write and schedule our promotional emails and blog posts for posting through our ad partners •Turn CEO-provided ideas, observations, meeting notes and industry insights into first drafts of CEO Connect and other thought-leadership communications, preserving the CEO's voice and point of view for his final review. •Publish 1–2 blog posts per month aligned to our SEO/AEO roadmap (we have an audit and keyword direction — you execute against it). •Turn wins into proof: case studies, testimonials, and review snippets we can reuse across channels. Work efficiently across channels by repurposing strong source content and using AI appropriately for drafting and production. 3. Light social media and website maintenance •Keep Facebook and LinkedIn active (roughly 1–2 posts/week) by repurposing blog, email, and event content — consistency over volume. •Promote our presence before, during, and after trade shows; celebrate customer milestones and company news. •Responding to social comments and reviews on Google, etc •Periodic content updates to our Wordpress website—You do not need to be a professional web designer. 4. Lead attribution and funnel management •Own lead-source data quality in HubSpot: every new lead tagged with channel and source (referral, event, web/AI search, advertising, cold outreach) so we know what’s working. •Produce a simple monthly lead-source and funnel report for the sales and leadership team. •Own event lead capture end-to-end: badge scans and booth conversations get into HubSpot and enrolled in follow-up sequences within days, not weeks. Own the marketing process for systematically generating customer and partner referrals, including identifying appropriate moments to ask, developing campaigns and communications, coordinating referral incentives where appropriate, and tracking referral results. 5. Conference planning and logistics •Quarterback our trade show calendar (OHI, KOA, Campground Owners Expo, and the Glamping Show are our keystones): registrations, sponsorship and ad deadlines, booth services, and company profiles. •Coordinate booth and swag shipping, hotel blocks, and travel deadlines with our internal event support — you run the checklist and the calendar so nothing books late or ships late. •Run a simple pre-event protocol: staffing confirmed before we commit, meetings booked before we arrive, follow-up ready before we leave. Proactively identify speaking, panel, roundtable, sponsorship and thought-leadership opportunities that position Tengo above the noise of the exhibit hall. Work with leadership and Sales before key events to identify target accounts, relationship introductions and meetings we want to create. •Deliver a short post-event recap: leads captured, meetings held, cost, and what we’d change. What success looks like in the first 90 days •Fall/winter event season (Glamping Show, OHI, KOA, and others) runs on a documented checklist with zero missed deadlines. •A monthly customer email and a steady social cadence are live and on-brand. •Every new lead in HubSpot carries a source, and leadership sees a monthly report they trust. •Event leads are followed up within one week via a repeatable sequence. What this role is not •Not a CMO or strategy role — leadership sets direction; you’ll have a seat at our standing marketing meeting and real input, but this is an execution-first engagement. •Not a HubSpot architecture project — specialist help handles complex automation builds; you need to be fluent, not an architect. •Not a heavy paid-media role — we run modest industry advertising, not large ad budgets. •Not a social media content creator role -- we don’t need tons of video production, etc You’re a fit if you have •4+ years of B2B marketing experience as a hands-on generalist — ideally supporting a relationship-driven sales team. •Strong writing chops: you can shift between a practical educational email, a CEO’s voice, and a blog post that reads like a human wrote it. •Working fluency in HubSpot (email, lists, forms, basic workflows, reporting). •Real event/trade show operations experience — you’ve owned deadlines, vendors, shipping, and travel logistics before. •The fractional mindset: self-managing, deadline-driven, comfortable flexing hours up during event season and down in quieter months. •Comfort using AI tools to draft faster without letting them write on autopilot. Bonus points: outdoor hospitality / campground / RV industry familiarity; WordPress; Canva or Adobe; Google Ads; SEO/AEO experience. Engagement details •Independent contractor (1099) on a monthly retainer of $3,000–$5,000 depending on experience and scope, at roughly 10–15 hours/week. •Initial 90-day engagement with the intent of a long-term ongoing relationship. •You’ll work day-to-day with our fractional sales leader and internal event support, with a standing marketing meeting alongside our CEO and sales leader. observations.description: Location: Remote — Anywhere (Open to applicants located anywhere around the globe.) Fueled is a leading digital strategy, design, and engineering agency. We are a 300+ person team that has designed and built hundreds of digital products and experiences for brands like Google, Apple, The New York Times, ESPN, Victoria’s Secret, MGM Resorts, Albertsons, and CLEAR. As a Contract Senior Web Engineer at Fueled, your mission is to architect the foundational systems that power dynamic, large-scale digital experiences. You will define the technical backbone of our projects, leveraging deep WordPress expertise to build robust, scalable solutions with modern PHP and sophisticated Gutenberg architecture. Your work bridges critical business needs and elegant technical execution, ensuring the platforms you build are performant, maintainable, and capable of evolving with our clients' ambitions. By setting a high bar for back-end craftsmanship and mentoring through your code, you'll leave a lasting imprint on our products, our team, and the millions of users who interact with your work. Intentionally remote, our team thrives in a culture that values flexibility, creativity, and cutting-edge technology. Together, we’re shaping the future of digital experiences. What you will do: Architect and build the core of enterprise-level WordPress solutions, developing high-performance plugins and themes with modern PHP and sophisticated Gutenberg blocks in React.js. Define the back-end technical vision and strategy for large-scale projects, making critical decisions on architecture, performance, and scalability that set the stage for long-term success. Elevate the entire team's output by providing expert code reviews that champion code quality, security, and maintainability. Solve complex performance and caching challenges, transforming slow, brittle systems into fast, resilient platforms that can handle millions of visitors. Your work will become the foundation upon which our clients build, creating the tools and systems that power digital experiences for a global audience. What you will achieve: Within your first month, you'll have taken ownership of a significant back-end feature or system, shipping code that demonstrates your architectural expertise. By the 3-month mark, a performance or caching improvement you championed will have resulted in a measurable increase in site speed or stability for a client project. Your technical guidance will have directly shaped a project's strategy, with your architectural recommendations being implemented and praised by both the team and the client. You will have established a new pattern or best practice for WordPress development that has been adopted by other engineers, elevating the team's collective output. By the end of your contract, you'll leave behind a legacy of robust, well-architected systems that continue to perform at scale and a standing invitation for future collaboration. About you: You have a deep passion for pushing WordPress to its limits, with expert-level mastery in modern PHP and a sophisticated understanding of the Gutenberg ecosystem. Your GitHub is a testament to your craft, filled with real-world WordPress code that demonstrates your ability to build elegant, scalable solutions – no whiteboard tests needed. You are a strategic partner and communicator, comfortable leading technical discussions with clients and translating their business needs into a powerful technical vision. You are a master of the back-end development lifecycle, with extensive Git workflow experience and a proven ability to expertly debug and optimize complex systems. You thrive on a distributed team, proactively collaborating and leading from the remote location of your choice to deliver exceptional results. Contractor fee Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, projects, geographic location, and business needs. Join our Contractor Pool This role is designed as a contract position, offering you the opportunity to experience our team and culture while showcasing your contributions. When the fit and business needs align, some contractors are invited to explore a transition into full-time roles. If you are passionate about Fueled's mission and think you have what it takes to be successful in this role, even if you don't check all the boxes - please apply. We'd appreciate the opportunity to review your application. Everyone gets a response. Upon meeting the necessary criteria, you'll join the Fueled contractor network, granting you access to project invitations tailored to your expertise and availability when they arise. Any data provided will be processed in accordance with applicable law and our privacy policy . Curious about what to expect during our talent process? Check it out here . We don't want you to miss any communication from us! To ensure you receive updates on your application, please add jobs@fueled.com to your contacts list! #LI-Remote

observations.description: Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 120,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers. That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first. As our new Senior Product Designer , you'll lead and execute product initiatives from concept to UI, bringing a user-focused mentality to everything you ship. You'll join a small, close-knit Product Design team, report to the Head of Product, partner day to day with Research, Product Management, and Development, and work with other teams as collaborators and stakeholders. It's a hands-on senior design role with the opportunity to grow into leading the PD team as it scales, while staying close to the design work Your primary canvas is MyKinsta, the dashboard where our customers manage their sites, but your scope also extends to the service layer to cover the full user experience of Kinsta. This means a design output can include internal workflows, customer communication, or additional tooling. You'll work with a high level of autonomy while you design features, manage stakeholders, provide UX guidance, and occasionally step in to own a project through delivery. The ideal Kinsta Senior Product Designer is a strong craftsperson, a confident decision-maker, curious, collaborative, and self-motivated. What You'll Do: Own design projects end to end (concept, scoping, user flows, UI, release, and follow-up), at any scale, from small improvements to strategic new capabilities. Drive discovery: define what to build to address real problems and user needs, and study competitors and best practices. Work closely with Research, Product Management, and Development: request and apply insights, align on business requirements, and validate technical feasibility. Write clear specifications so design intent is unambiguous, and run design QA against both the intent and the Kinsta Design System. Give clear rationale for your decisions, resolve design and product deadlocks, escalate when you need feedback or mediation, and communicate trade-offs when priorities compete. Serve as Project Owner on occasion. We don't have full-time delivery managers, so one team member leads each project as its Owner during delivery, communicating progress and coordinating releases. Be a product expert: know how our product works, the personas and use cases we support, and how that translates into UI-level design solutions. Represent the craft: uphold professional standards in design thinking, problem solving, usability, UX, and UI; give and receive design critique; and help maintain and evolve the Kinsta Design System. What You Bring To The Role: A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience as a Product or UX Designer. Demonstrated experience shipping products and features from zero to production, with the ability to carry a project fully autonomously. Experience working in a SaaS environment, on a highly technical product, in cross-functional teams. Hands-on experience across the full design workflow: research, problem definition, ideation and facilitation, creating UI, and partnering in delivery. Expert-level proficiency with Figma. Experience working with and maintaining a design system. A portfolio with at least one case study taking a project from a problem statement to a delivered solution. We want to see your process and how you arrived at decisions, not only screens and a general workflow description. A good understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JS). You don't need to write production code, but you should have a working sense of feasibility and be comfortable poking at things in an Inspector. Proactivity: you take the initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do. Professional-level English with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Bonus if you have: Experience working on a hosting or web infrastructure product. Experience with technical products where the audience is developers or technology-oriented users. Experience with the WordPress ecosystem. Experience mentoring or leading other designers. Benefits: Annual remote expense budget. Flexible PTO. Paid parental leave. Annual professional development budget: available after one year with Kinsta. Sabbatical: available after three years with Kinsta (and every three years thereafter). Location-specific healthcare benefits (includes vision and dental) for employees hired in the USA, UK, Canada, and Hungary. Pension plan for employees hired in the UK, and 401k contributions for employees hired in the USA. Compensation Additional Information Kinsta is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate and we will take actions to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, citizenship, age, religion, creed, disability, marital status, veteran’s status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. By applying to one of our positions, you agree to the processing of the submitted personal data in accordance with Kinsta's Privacy Policy , including the transfer of your data to the United States. #LI-Remote, #IHSRemote

observations.description: Growth Marketer (6-Month Contract) Location: Remote - US About Worldly Worldly is the world’s most comprehensive impact intelligence platform — delivering real data to businesses on impacts within their supply chain. Worldly is trusted by 40,000 global brands, retailers, and manufacturers to provide the single source of ESG intelligence they need to accelerate business and industry transformation. Through strategic and meaningful customer relationships, Worldly provides key insights around supplier performance, product impact, trends analysis, and compliance. When a company wants to change how business is done, we enable that systemic shift. Backed by a dedicated global team of individuals aligned by values, Worldly proudly operates as a public benefit corporation with backing from mission-aligned investors. Want to learn more? Read our story . About The Role Worldly is hiring a contractor to execute our growth marketing campaigns and report on how they perform. This is a hands-on execution role embedded in our marketing team. You take campaigns from brief to launch to results readout: you build the emails and HubSpot workflows, launch the LinkedIn and Google Ads campaigns, set up the landing pages, QA everything, and pull the reports that tell us what worked. You will also own answer engine optimization (AEO). Our buyers now do a lot of their research in tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, and we want to know how Worldly shows up in those answers. You will measure it, track it over time, and run the plan to improve how often and how accurately we get cited. This is a position for one person working with the marketing team. It is not a project for an agency or a consultancy, and it is not a fractional gig you fit in around other clients. If you would be subcontracting the work or bringing a team, this is not the right fit. What You'll Do Campaign execution Execute campaigns end-to-end across paid, email, organic, events support, and content syndication, aimed at high-value accounts and buying committees in the consumer goods sector. Do the hands-on work yourself: configure HubSpot workflows, launch and manage LinkedIn and Google Ads campaigns, build landing pages, and QA every asset before it goes live. Support account-based marketing (ABM) programs (1:many and 1:few) with our Growth (sales) team, targeting the decision-makers at the accounts sales cares about most. Run a test-and-learn motion: launch small, measure, retire what is not working, and scale what is. Experiments need to show positive returns to earn a larger budget. Campaign reporting and performance Own campaign reporting and dashboards in HubSpot and Google Analytics, including attribution, lead quality, and pipeline contribution across the funnel (Lead, MQL, SAL, SQL). Deliver a weekly performance readout to marketing and sales. Tell us plainly what is working, what is not, and where you would recommend we move the budget. Keep campaign workflows and reporting infrastructure clean and reliable, with a clear marketing-to-sales handoff and feedback loop. AEO: measure, track, and improve Measure and track Worldly’s visibility in AI answer engines: how often we get cited, our share of voice against competitors, and how accurately Worldly (and the Higg Index, available through Worldly) is described. Build and maintain an AEO scorecard, reported monthly, so we can see whether we are gaining or losing ground. Develop and execute AEO improvement plans: content recommendations, page structure and schema changes, whatever makes Worldly content easier for AI engines to find and cite. You work with our content and web owners to actually ship the fixes. We'd Like to See 6+ years of hands-on B2B SaaS marketing execution, including demand generation and ABM campaigns you personally built, launched, and reported on. Expertise in our stack: HubSpot (workflows, email, reporting), WordPress (website), LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and Google Analytics. ABM platform experience (ZoomInfo) a plus. Working knowledge of AEO/GEO: you have measured how brands show up in AI answer engines and improved it, or you are an experienced SEO practitioner who has extended into AI search and can show results. Strong analytical and reporting habits. You are comfortable with pipeline metrics and attribution, and you can explain results to sales and marketing leaders without a glossary. You have worked closely with sales teams before and delivered leads they actually wanted. Fluent with AI tools and genuinely excited to experiment with them. You already use AI daily in your own marketing work. Available full-time (roughly 40 hours per week) with overlap across U.S. and APAC business hours, based in the U.S., and able to work as an independent contractor. Contract Details Hours: 40 hours per week Compensation: $75 - $100 hourly Location : Remote Contract Details: This role will start as a 6-month contract. Worldly reserves the right to end the contract with 30 days' notice. Depending on company strategy and performance, this contractor role has the potential to extend into a longer-term contract or convert to an FTE position. Life at Worldly Our team is motivated to transform the way products are made. By helping our customers succeed in a new era of sustainable production, we are able to build technology that makes a difference on a planetary level. Our team represents over 15 countries, and brings unique experiences from technology to farming to the table. Surround yourself with kind, enthusiastic, and dedicated people who put collaboration and growth at the center of our shared goals. General Travel Notice ​​Roles at Worldly may require occasional travel to support business needs, including but not limited to team collaboration, customer engagement, or company events. Equity Statement We believe it’s essential to reflect the diversity of those we strive to serve. True innovation happens when everyone has room at the table, including the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. We’re dedicated to building a culturally and experientially diverse team that leads and works with empathy and respect.

observations.description: Company Overview LevelUp is a specialist agency providing outsourcing solutions to agencies, software vendors, and website owners. For over seven years, we have successfully collaborated with various companies, delivering valuable technical, operational, and back-office support. We boast a large team of skilled and passionate professionals committed to producing high-quality work for our clients. Position Overview We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented L1 Hosting Tech Support Agent to join our team. In this critical, frontline, customer-facing role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for clients seeking technical assistance with their hosting environments and WordPress websites. Leveraging your passion for customer service and solid foundational knowledge of web hosting, you will troubleshoot and resolve a broad spectrum of technical issues via live chat and ticket-based support. Since stellar client experiences are highly valued, you will be expected to multitask efficiently by managing two to three concurrent live chat channels during busy periods while maintaining excellent response times, a high-quality assurance (QA) score, and top-tier Customer Satisfaction (CSAT). This is a full-time, long-term opportunity embedded in an active, supportive team. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love solving technical puzzles, and enjoy delivering empathetic, world-class customer service, we would love to have you on board! This fully remote position requires working a fixed mid-shift or night-shift Monday through Friday with no schedule flexibility, observing standard Philippine holidays. Reference: 2634-323775 Responsibilities Provide world-class technical support to hosting customers via live chat (managing 2 concurrent chats, scaling up to 3 during high-volume periods) and ticket-based support via Zendesk. Diagnose and resolve common web hosting and WordPress issues, identifying root causes to solve customer inquiries on the first contact whenever possible. Assist customers with general WordPress tasks, including troubleshooting issues related to core files, plugins, themes, and configuration errors. Answer server-side queries, inspect DNS records, check and update SSL certificates, and troubleshoot website accessibility issues. Handle basic database queries and migrations (MySQL) to resolve backend errors and facilitate site movement. Utilize basic Linux command-line tools to diagnose, navigate, and troubleshoot server-side issues. Meticulously document issues and escalate complex, tier-2 technical problems to senior teams to ensure service continuity. Actively meet and exceed key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), Average Handling Time (AHT), QA scores, Acceptance Rate, and Average Customer Wait Time. Maintain an active, highly responsive online presence via Slack and Zendesk during your entire shift. Requirements 1 to 2 years of solid technical support experience specifically working in a web hosting environment. Basic to intermediate knowledge of WordPress, with a demonstrated ability to identify and troubleshoot plugin, theme, and configuration conflicts. Proven experience with FTP/SFTP, cPanel, or custom web hosting dashboards. Strong understanding of DNS zone files (A records, CNAME, TXT) and SSL setup. Basic knowledge of HTTP response status codes (e.g., 500, 404, 403, 502, 504). Experience with MySQL databases, including running simple queries or basic site migrations. Excellent multitasking capabilities, specifically the capacity to handle 2 to 3 concurrent live chat windows smoothly and accurately. Outstanding written and verbal English communication skills, with a conversational, natural flow and minimal grammatical errors. A warm, empathetic customer support style that prioritizes active listening, rapport-building, and customer advocacy. Practical experience navigating files and running basic diagnostic commands via Linux CLI. A bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred (nice-to-have), but equivalent hands-on experience will be highly considered. More Information This is a fully remote position with a standard 40-hour fixed-schedule work week. The exact work schedule depends on the client that you are assigned to but is often an afternoon or night schedule and so having flexibility when it comes to schedule is important. We have a company culture that focuses on the well-being of its team members, with a good work life balance and respectful work environment. Equipment provided HMO + 13th month pay and other government-mandated benefits Compensation Additional Information

observations.description: About Us At Envato, we empower creative pros to thrive. We're here to help creatives bring their ideas to life, supercharge their workflows, and equip them with an unparalleled toolkit they can use anywhere. With unlimited access to world-class assets, innovative AI tools, and hands-on tutorials, we deliver what creatives need today - and are continually evolving our offering. As AI transforms the creative landscape, we’re committed to building what’s next for the future. We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow. You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024. About the role The Senior Reviewer, Code & Web Templates is responsible for reviewing, assessing, and maintaining quality standards across Envato’s broad code and web template categories, including Web Themes & UI Templates, Template Kits, WordPress, WordPress Plugins, Scripts, Plugins, and Code assets. As Envato continues to evolve its Content Operations model, this role will help consolidate review expertise into a smaller, stronger, and more scalable team in Mexico. The Senior Reviewer will be expected to apply expert judgment across the full Code Review landscape, ensuring that submissions meet Envato’s technical, usability, security, originality, documentation, and commercial-quality expectations. This role plays a critical part in protecting customer trust, supporting contributor quality, improving review consistency, and helping Envato maintain a high-quality marketplace experience across its web, theme, template, and code categories. What you'll be doing Scope of Review Coverage This role may review and support quality decisions across the following asset groups: - Web Themes & UI Templates. - Site Templates. - UI Templates. - Template Kits. - ThemeForest categories, excluding areas that require separate specialists. handling where applicable. - WordPress themes. - WordPress plugins. - Scripts. - Plugins. - Code assets. - Front-end templates and components. - Admin dashboards, landing pages, HTML templates, and related web products. - PHP, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, and CMS-based assets. Deep specialization in every domain is not required from the outset. However, this role requires a strong full-stack technical foundation, practical hands-on experience, and the learning agility necessary to effectively review, assess, and contribute across all relevant areas at a high professional standard. Content Review & Quality Assessment Review and assess submissions across all code and web template categories against Envato’s technical, quality, usability, documentation, security, and commercial standards. Apply review criteria consistently across all asset types, including design quality, code quality, functionality, responsiveness, browser compatibility, accessibility, performance, security, dependency management, documentation, installation and setup experience, originality, and commercial value, while adapting standards to the specific expectations of each category. Identify and reject submissions that do not meet marketplace standards, including those with poor code quality, broken functionality, inadequate documentation, security concerns, excessive dependencies, low originality, poor usability, intellectual property risks, or limited commercial value. Provide clear, objective, and constructive review outcomes aligned with established review guidelines. Risk Management & Escalation Identify complex, ambiguous, or high-risk submissions and escalate them to the appropriate stakeholders for further review. Recognize emerging category risks, contributor patterns, and quality concerns that may impact marketplace standards or customer trust. Standards, Documentation & Continuous Improvement Support calibration activities to ensure consistency and alignment of review standards across the Code Review team. Contribute to the development and maintenance of review documentation, category standards, technical benchmarks, and reviewer enablement materials. Identify recurring contributor issues, operational bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve review quality, efficiency, and consistency. Stay current with modern web development practices, WordPress, JavaScript frameworks, UI/UX trends, plugin ecosystems, marketplace expectations, and AI-assisted development trends. Team Collaboration & Operational Support Partner with Content Operations leaders to support the evolution of the review function, including the transition from a larger contractor model to a smaller, highly skilled, cross-functional Mexico-based review team. Maintain productivity and turnaround expectations while ensuring quality, consistency, and customer trust are not compromised. Act as a subject matter expert in code and web template review, supporting team knowledge sharing, reviewer development, and continuous improvement initiatives. About you Key Capabilities Strong full-stack development background with practical experience across front-end and back-end web development, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, WordPress themes and plugins, scripts, and web templates - covering responsive design, browser compatibility, performance optimization, and accessibility basics. Strong understanding of WordPress ecosystems including template hierarchy, installation workflows, customization, dependencies, and common marketplace quality issues. Strong understanding of clean code practices, file organization, naming conventions, documentation standards, version compatibility, and user setup experience. Ability to identify common technical risks including broken functionality, poor code structure, weak security practices, performance issues, unsupported dependencies, and poor customer usability. Strong eye for commercial quality, customer value, modern design execution, and marketplace relevance. Ability to use AI-assisted tools to support review throughput, code analysis, and other workflow and productivity efficiencies. Ability to make consistent, objective, and well-reasoned review decisions across multiple asset categories. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly and professionally. High attention to detail with the ability to identify technical and quality issues quickly. Comfortable maintaining strong quality standards while meeting productivity and turnaround expectations. Ability to collaborate with global teams in a remote or hybrid environment. Fluent or strong professional proficiency in English. Required Technical Coverage This role requires solid working knowledge across several relevant technical domains, with the adaptability and learning agility needed to develop proficiency across the broader review scope over time. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive web development PHP and WordPress development. WordPress themes and plugin ecosystems. Site Templates and UI Templates. Template Kits and page-builder-based assets. Scripts, plugins, and reusable code products. Installation, configuration, dependency management and documentation review. Code quality, security basics, compatibility, performance, and maintainability. Marketplace asset quality standards and customer usability expectations. Additional Experience Previous experience reviewing or creating assets for a digital marketplace. Familiarity with Envato’s marketplaces, including ThemeForest and CodeCanyon. Deeper specialisation in one or more areas beyond the required technical coverage. Experience in QA, technical validation, software testing, content review, or marketplace operations. Familiarity with intellectual property, licensing, open-source dependencies, and AI-assisted code generation risks as they apply to marketplace submissions. Experience supporting process improvement, reviewer calibration, documentation, or category quality standards. Compensation Additional Information Life at Envato • Flexible Working: remote-first with flexibility for you to manage work and life as you need. • Work from Anywhere: apply to work in another location for up to 3 months per calendar year. • Conoce Mexico: a unique travel benefit for you to explore and visit new places across Mexico. • Connection Budget: an annual budget to connect with the team IRL where and when possible. • Learning Budget - Study leave and an annual budget for you to put towards your learning and development. • Home Office Allowance: contribution towards your set-up and a monthly allowance to support work from home costs. • Wellbeing: access to a holistic assistance program that provides support in many areas of life and health. • Volunteer Leave: 2 days per calendar year to volunteer and give back to the community. • Parental Leave: 20 weeks paid primary carer leave, and 6 weeks paid secondary carers leave. • Christmas Bonus, Paid Holidays and Holiday Bonus: we offer 30 days paid in December, you will have 12 days vacation in the first year, and you will earn 100% of holiday bonus. • Grocery tickets: we offer you a monthly amount of 5% (subject to the legal cap) in food vouchers, which can be used in markets, pharmacies and more. • 5% Saving Funds (fondo de ahorro). • Private Health Insurance (SGMM). • Unlimited Ebooks. By submitting your application you are agreeing to our Privacy Policy. If you would like to understand how we handle personal information before submitting your application, please read through our Privacy Policy. Research shows candidates from neurodiverse and underrepresented backgrounds often only apply for roles if they meet all the criteria. We like to make our hiring decisions based on lived experience, so if you’re keen to apply and need reasonable adjustments please let us know. observations.description: Location: Remote — EMEA (Open to applicants in Europe, the Middle East and Africa) Fueled is a leading digital strategy, design, and engineering agency. We are a 300+ person team that has designed and built hundreds of digital products and experiences for brands like Google, Apple, The New York Times, ESPN, Victoria’s Secret, MGM Resorts, Albertsons, and CLEAR. As a Lead UX Designer at Fueled, you’ll thrive by embracing ambiguity and turning it into an opportunity. You’ll use each new problem as a chance to build something meaningful, collaborate with a cross-functional team, and prioritize action that moves projects forward. By creating thoughtful solutions, supporting great work across the team, and staying curious, you’ll make an impact that’s felt by users, clients, and your peers. Intentionally remote, our team thrives in a culture that values flexibility, creativity, and cutting-edge technology. Together, we’re shaping the future of digital experiences. What you will do: Lead end-to-end UX direction across client engagements, shaping experiences that are intuitive, scalable, and ready to ship. Collaborate closely with UX, design, and engineering teams to define scope, clarify priorities, and make smart tradeoffs that protect the user experience. Translate ambiguous business goals into clear user journeys, IA, and interaction models that teams can confidently build from, while developing UX patterns and design foundations that improve consistency and accelerate delivery. Facilitate alignment across client stakeholders and internal teams by guiding workshops and turning competing inputs into actionable decisions, supported by easy-to-understand deliverables. Leverage real CMS experience—ideally WordPress—to design effectively within the structure of content models, templates, and reusable blocks. What you will achieve: Deliver UX work that improves real product outcomes, such as higher conversion, stronger engagement, clearer navigation, or smoother onboarding experiences. Create clarity early by turning open questions into structured flows, priorities, and decisions that teams can build with confidence. Ship work you’re proud of, raising the bar for usability, polish, and thoughtful interaction design across client projects. Strengthen collaboration across teams by improving how clients, product, design, and engineering align and move forward together. Grow as a Lead UX Designer through feedback, iteration, and working closely with a tight team of people who care about craft. About you: You have 6+ years of experience designing digital products and leading UX work across complex web and/or mobile experiences, including hands-on work within content management systems (WordPress strongly preferred). You thrive in busy environments and know how to bring structure, clarity, and momentum without overcomplicating the process. You ask great questions early and aren't afraid to seek input, challenge assumptions, or pull in the right people to get to the best outcome. You collaborate naturally across disciplines, building strong relationships with clients, product teams, and engineers to keep work moving forward. You have a track record of shipping work you're proud of, delivering thoughtful, polished UX that improves usability, engagement, or conversion. Contractor Fee Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors including relevant experience, projects, geographic location, and business needs. Join our Contractor Pool This role is designed as a contract position, offering you the opportunity to experience our team and culture while showcasing your contributions. When the fit and business needs align, some contractors are invited to explore a transition into full-time roles. If you are passionate about Fueled's mission and think you have what it takes to be successful in this role, please apply. We'd appreciate the opportunity to review your application. Everyone gets a response. Upon meeting the necessary criteria, you'll join the Fueled contractor network, granting you access to project invitations tailored to your expertise and availability when they arise. Any data provided will be processed in accordance with applicable law and our privacy policy . Curious about what to expect during our talent process? Check it out here . We don't want you to miss any communication from us! To ensure you receive updates on your application, please add jobs@fueled.com to your contacts list!

observations.description: Are you ready to elevate our digital presence and leverage cutting-edge AI tools to scale high-quality marketing campaigns?
